Yeh sun kar Ubay ibn Khalaf khara ho kar kehnay laga ae Abu-ul-Fazl tum jhoot kehtay ho. Aap ne farmaya ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai. Us ne kaha achha main das das oontniyon ki shart badta hoon. Agar teen saal tak Roomi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye toh main tumhein das oontniyan doonga warna tum mujhay dena. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne yeh shart qabool kar li. Phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aa kar is ka zikr kiya toh aap ne kaha main ne tum se teen saal ka nahin kaha tha, 'biz' ka lafz Quran mein hai aur teen se nau tak bola jata hai. Jao oontniyan bhi barha do aur muddat bhi barha do. Hazrat Abu Bakr chalay, jab Ubay ke paas pohanchay toh woh kehnay laga shayad tumhein pachtawa hua? Aap ne farmaya suno main toh pehlay se bhi zyada tayyar ho kar aaya hoon. Aao muddat bhi barhao aur shart ka maal bhi zyada karo. Chunancha ek sau oont muqarrar huay aur nau saal ki muddat thehri, isi muddat mein Roomi Fars par ghalib aa gaye aur Musalman Quraish par chha gaye.

Rumiyon ke ghalbe ka waqia yun hua ke jab Fars ghalib aagaye toh Shahr-e-Baraz ka bhai Farkhan sharab noshi karte hue kehne laga main ne dekha hai ke goya main Kisra ke takht par aagaya hoon aur Fars ka badshah ban gaya hoon. Yeh khabar Kisra ko bhi pahunch gayi. Kisra ne Shahr-e-Baraz ko likha ke mera yeh khat paate hi apne is bhai ko qatl karke iska sar mere paas bhej do. Shahr-e-Baraz ne likha ke ae badshah tum itni jaldi na karo. Farkhan jaisa bahadur sher aur jurrat ke sath dushmanon ke jamghate mein ghusne wala kisi ko tum na paoge. Badshah ne phir jawab likha ke is se bahut zyada aur sher dil pehlwan mere darbar mein ek se behtar ek maujood hain tum is ka gham na karo aur mere hukm ki foran tameel karo. Shahr-e-Baraz ne phir is ka jawab likha aur dobara badshah Kisra ko samjhaya is par badshah aag bagola hogaya us ne elaan kardiya ke Shahr-e-Baraz se main ne sardari chheen li aur is ki jagah is ke bhai Farkhan ko apne lashkar ka sipah salar muqarrar kardiya. Isi mazmoon ka ek khat likh kar qasid ke hamrah Shahr-e-Baraz ko bhej diya ke tum aaj se ma'zool ho aur tum apna ohda Farkhan ko de do. Sath hi qasid ko ek posheeda khat diya ke Shahr-e-Baraz jab apne ohde se utar jaye aur Farkhan is ohde par aajaye toh tum use mera yeh farman de dena. Qasid jab wahan pahuncha toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne khat parhte hi kaha ke mujhe badshah ka hukm manzoor hai, main bakhushi apna ohda Farkhan ko de raha hoon. Farkhan jab takht-e-saltanat par baith gaya aur lashkar ne is ki itaat qabool karli toh qasid ne woh doosra khat Farkhan ke samne pesh kiya jis mein Shahr-e-Baraz ke qatl ka aur is ka sar darbar-e-shahi mein bhejne ka farman tha. Farkhan ne ise parh kar Shahr-e-Baraz ko bulaya aur is ki gardan maarne ka hukm de diya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne kaha badshah jaldi na kar mujhe wasiyat toh likh lene de. Us ne manzoor karliya toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne apna daftar mangwaya aur is mein woh kaghazat jo Shah-e-Kisra ne Farkhan ke qatl ke liye use likhe the woh sab nikale aur Farkhan ke samne pesh kiye aur kaha dekh itne sawal-o-jawab mere aur badshah ke darmiyan tere bare mein hue. Lekin main ne apni aqalmandi se kaam liya aur ajlat na ki, tu ek khat dekhte hi mere qatl par amada hogaya. Zara soch le. In khatoot ko dekh kar Farkhan ki aankhein khul gayin woh foran takht se neeche utar gaya aur apne bhai Shahr-e-Baraz ko phir se malik-e-kul banadiya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne isi waqt Shah-e-Rum Heraclius (Harqal) ko khat likha ke mujhe tum se khufiya mulaqat karni hai aur ek zaroori amr mein mashwara karna hai, ise main na toh kisi qasid ki marifat aap ko kehwa sakta hoon na khat mein likh sakta hoon. Balkeh main khud hi aamne samne pesh karunga. Pachas aadmi apne sath le kar khud aajaye aur pachas hi mere sath honge. Qaisar ko jab yeh paigham pahuncha toh woh is se mulaqat ke liye chal para. Lekin ehtiyatan apne sath paanch hazar sawar le liye.

Aur aage aage jasuson ko bhej diya taake koi makr ya fareb ho toh khul jaye. Jasuson ne aakar khabar di ke koi baat nahin aur Shahrbaraz tanha apne saath sirf pachaas sawaron ko lekar aaya hai, uske saath koi aur nahin. Chunancha Qaisar ne bhi mutma'in ho kar apne sawaron ko lota diya aur apne saath sirf pachaas aadmi rakh liye. Jo jagah mulaqat ki muqarrar hui thi wahan pahunch gaye. Wahan ek reshmi qubba tha, us mein jakar dono tanha baith gaye, pachaas pachaas aadmi alag chhod diye gaye, dono wahan be-hathiyar thay sirf chhuriyan paas thin aur dono ki taraf se ek tarjuman saath tha. Khaime mein pahunch kar Shahrbaraz ne kaha, "Ae Badshah-e-Rum! Baat yeh hai ke tumhare mulk ko veeran karne wale aur tumhare lashkaron ko shikast dene wale hum dono bhai hain, humne apni chalakiyon aur shuja'at se yeh mulk apne qabze mein kar liya hai. Lekin ab hamara badshah Kisra hamara hasad karta hai aur hamara mukhalif ban baitha hai, mujhe usne mere bhai ko qatl karne ka farman bheja, maine farman ko na mana toh usne ab yeh tay kar liya hai ke hum aapke lashkar mein aa jayen aur Kisra ke lashkaron se aapke saath ho kar ladein." Qaisar ne yeh baat badi khushi se manzoor kar li. Phir un dono mein aapas mein isharon kinayon se baatein huin jin ka matlab yeh tha ke yeh dono tarjuman qatl kar diye jayen, aisa na ho ke yeh raaz unki wajah se khul jaye kyunke jahan do ke siwa teesre ke kaan mein koi baat pahunchi toh phir woh phail jati hai. Dono is par ittefaq karke khade ho gaye aur har ek ne apne tarjuman ka kaam tamam kar diya. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne Kisra ko halak kar diya aur Hudaibiya wale din uski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko mili, Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) is se bahut khush hue. Yeh siyaq ajeeb hai aur yeh khabar ghareeb hai. Ab aayat ke alfaaz ke mutaliq suniye. Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein hote hain unki behas toh hum kar chuke hain, Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein dekh lijiye. Roomi sab ke sab 'Iys bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim ki nasl se hain, Bani Israel ke chacha zaad bhai hain. Roomiyon ko Banu Asfar bhi kehte hain, yeh Yunaniyon ke mazhab par thay, Yunani Yafis bin Nuh ki aulad mein hain, Turkon ke chacha zaad bhai hote hain, yeh sitara parast thay, saaton sitaron ko maante aur poojte thay. Inhein Mutahayyira bhi kaha jata hai, yeh Qutb-e-Shamali ko qibla maante thay. Damishq ki bina inhi ke hathon padi, wahin unhone apni ibadat-gah banayi jis ke mehrab shumal ki taraf hain. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki nabuwwat ke baad bhi teen sau saal tak Roomi apne purane khayalat par hi rahe, un mein se jo koi Sham ka aur Jazeere ka badshah ho jata use Qaisar kaha jata tha. Sab se pehle Roomiyon ka badshah Qustuntin bin Qustus ne Nasrani mazhab qabool kiya. Uski maa ka naam Maryam tha, Hailaniya Ghunduqaniya thi, Harran ki rehne wali. Pehle isi ne Nasraniyat qabool ki thi, phir uske kehne sunne se uske bete ne bhi yahi mazhab ikhtiyar kar liya. Yeh bada falsafi, aqalmand aur makkar aadmi tha.

Yeh bhi mashhoor hai ke us ne darasal dil se is mazhab ko nahin mana tha. Us ke zamane mein Nasrani jama hogaye. Un mein aapas mein mazhabi chher-chhar aur ikhtilaf aur munazire chhir gaye. Abdullah bin Arius se bade bade munazire hue aur is qadar intishar aur tafreeq hui ke bayan se bahar hai. Teen sau athara padriyon ne mil kar ek kitab likhi jo badshah ko di gayi aur woh shahi aqeeda tasleem ki gayi. Isi ko Amanat-e-Kubra kaha jata hai, jo darhaqiqat Khayanat-e-Sughra hai. Yehin fiqhi kitabein isi ke zamane mein likhi gayin. Un mein halal haram ke masail bayan kiye gaye aur un ke ulama ne dil khol kar jo chaha un mein likha. Jis qadar ji mein aayi kami ya ziyadati asal deen-e-Masih mein ki aur asal mazhab muharraf-o-mubaddal hogaya. Mashriq ki janib namazein padhne lage. Bajaye hafta ke itwar ko bada din banaya. Saleeb ki parastish shuru hogayi. Khanzeer ko halal kar liya gaya aur bahut se tehwar ijad kar liye jaise Eid-e-Saleeb, Eid-e-Quds, Eid-e-Ghatas waghera waghera. Phir un ulama ke silsile qaim kiye gaye, ek to bada padri hota tha phir us ke neeche darja badarja aur mehkame hote thay. Rahbaniyat aur tark-e-duniya ki bid'at bhi ijad kar li. Kaleesa aur girje bahut sare bana liye gaye aur shehar Qustuntuniya ki bina rakhi gayi aur is bade shehar ko isi badshah ke naam par namzad kiya gaya. Is badshah ne barah hazar girje bana diye. Teen mehrabon se Bait-ul-Lahm bana. Us ki maa ne bhi Qumama banaya. In logon ko Malkiya kehte hain is liye ke yeh log apne badshah ke deen par thay. In ke baad Ya'qubiya phir Nasturiya. Yeh sab Nastur ke muqallid thay. Phir un ke bahut se giroh thay jaise hadith mein hai ke un ke bahattar (72) firqe hogaye. Un ki saltanat barabar chali aati thi, ek ke baad ek Qaisar hona aata tha yahan tak ke aakhir mein Qaisar Heraclius (Harqal) hua. Yeh tamam badshahon se ziyada aqalmand tha, bahut bada aalim tha, danai, ziraki, door-andeshi aur door-beeni mein apna sani nahin rakhta tha. Us ne saltanat bahut wasee kar li aur mamlikat door-daraz tak phaila di. Us ke muqable mein Fars ka badshah Kisra khada hua aur chhoti chhoti saltanaton ne bhi us ka sath diya, us ki saltanat Qaisar se bhi ziyada badi thi. Yeh Majusi log thay, aag ko poojte thay. Mandarja bala riwayat mein to hai ke us ka sipah salar muqable par gaya lekin mashhoor baat yeh hai ke khud Kisra us ke muqable par gaya. Qaisar ko shikast hui yahan tak ke woh Qustuntuniya mein ghir gaya. Nasrani us ki badi izzat aur ta'zeem karte thay, go Kisra lambi muddat tak muhasra kiye pada raha lekin dar-us-saltanat ko fath na kar saka. Ek wajah yeh bhi thi ke us ka mulk nisf samundar ki taraf tha aur nisf khushki ki taraf tha, to Shah-e-Qaisar ko kumak aur rasad tari ke raste se barabar pahunchti rahi. Aakhir mein Qaisar ne ek chaal chali, us ne Kisra ko kehwa bheja ke aap jo chahein mujh se tasalli le lijiye aur jin sharait par chahein mujh se sulah kar lijiye. Kisra us par raazi hogaya aur itna maal talab kiya ke woh aur yeh mil kar bhi jama karna chahein to namumkin tha.

Qaisar ne ise qabool kar liya kyunke usne is se Kisra ki bewaqoofi ka pata chala liya ke yeh woh cheez maangta hai jis ka jama karna duniya ke ikhtiyar se bahar hai, balkay saari duniya mil kar is ka daswan hissa bhi jama nahin kar sakti. Qaisar ne Kisra se kehlwa bheja ke mujhe ijazat de ke main apne mulk se bahar chal phir kar is daulat ko jama kar loon aur aap ko sonp doon. Usne yeh darkhwast manzoor kar li. Ab Shah-e-Room ne apne lashkar ko jama kiya aur un se kaha main ek zaroori aur ahem kaam ke liye apne makhsoos ahbab ke sath ja raha hoon. Agar ek saal ke andar andar aa jaoon to yeh mulk mera hai warna tumhein ikhtiyar hai jise chaho apna badshah tasleem kar lena. Unhon ne jawab diya ke hamare badshah to aap hi hain khwah das saal tak bhi aap na lautay to kya hua. Yeh yahan se mukhtasar si janbaz jamaat le kar chup chap chal khara hua. Posheeda raston se nihayat hoshiyari, ehtiyat aur chalaki se bohat jald Fars ke shehron tak pahunch gaya aur yak-a-yak dhawa bol diya, chunke yahan ki faujein to Room pahunch chuki thin, awam kahan tak muqabla karte. Usne qatl-e-aam shuru kiya. Jo samne aaya talwar ke kaam aaya, yunhi barhta chala gaya yahan tak ke Madain pahunch gaya jo Kisra ki saltanat ki kursi thi, wahan ki muhafiz fauj par bhi ghalib aaya, unhein bhi qatl kar diya aur charon taraf se maal jama kiya. Un ki tamam aurton ko qaid kar liya aur tamam larne walon ko qatl kar dala. Kisra ke larkay ko zinda giraftar kiya, us mehal-e-saraye ki aurton ko zinda giraftar kiya. Us ki darbardari aurtein waghera bhi pakri gayin, uske lashkar ka sar mundwa kar gadhay par bitha kar aurton samet Kisra ki taraf bheja ke lijiye jo maal aur aurtein aur ghulam tu ne mangay thay woh sab hazir hain. Jab yeh qafila Kisra ke paas pahuncha, Kisra ko sakht sadma hua. Yeh abhi tak Qustuntuniya ka muhasra kiye para tha aur Qaisar ki wapsi ka intezar kar raha tha ke us ke paas us ka kul khandan aur saari haram-sara is zillat ki halat mein pahunchi. Yeh sakht ghazabnak hua aur shehar par bohat sakht hamla kar diya lekin is mein koi kamyabi na hui. Ab yeh nehar-e-Jaihoon ki taraf chala ke Qaisar ko wahan rok le kyunke Qaisar ka Fars se Qustuntuniya aanay ka rasta yahi tha. Qaisar ne ise sun kar pehle se bhi zabardast hamla kiya, yani usne apne lashkar ko to darya ke is dahane chora aur khud thoray se aadmi le kar sawar ho kar pani ke bahao ki taraf chal diya. Koi ek din raat ka rasta chalne ke baad apne sath jo kayi chara, leed, gobar waghera le gaya tha use pani mein baha diya. Yeh cheezein pani mein behti hui Kisra ke lashkar ke paas se guzrin to woh samajh gaye ke Qaisar yahan se guzar gaya hai. Yeh us ke lashkaron ke janwaron ke aasar hain. Ab Qaisar wapas apne lashkar mein pahunch gaya, udhar Kisra us ki talash mein aagay chala gaya. Qaisar apne lashkaron samet Jaihoon ka dahana aboor kar ke rasta badal kar Qustuntuniya pahunch gaya. Jis din yeh apne dar-us-saltanat mein pahuncha, Nasraniyon mein bari khushiyan manayi gayin.

Kisra ko jab yeh ittila hui toh us ka ajab haal hua ke na paye mandan na jaye raftan, na toh Rum hi fath hua aur na Fars hi raha. Rumi ghalib aa gaye, Fars ki auratein aur wahan ke maal un ke qabze mein aaye. Yeh kul umoor nau saal mein hue aur Rumiyon ne apni khoi hui saltanat Farsiyon se dobara le li aur maghloob ho kar ghalib aa gaye. Azra'at aur Basra ke ma'arke mein Ahl-e-Fars ghalib aa gaye thay aur yeh mulk-e-Sham ka woh hissa tha jo Hijaz se milta tha, yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh hazimat Jazeerah mein hui thi jo Rumiyon ki sarhad ka maqam hai aur Fars se milta hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir nau saal ke andar andar Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Quran-e-Kareem mein lafz 'biz' ka hai aur is ka itlaq bhi nau tak hota hai aur yahi tafseer is lafz ki Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Jarir wali hadith mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se farmaya tha ke tumhein ehtiyatan das saal tak rakhne chahiye thay kyunke 'biz' ke lafz ka itlaq teen se nau tak hota hai. Is ke baad qabl aur ba'd par pesh izafat hata dene ki wajah hai ke is ke baad hukm Allah hi ka hai. Us din jab ke Rum Fars par ghalib aa jaye ga toh Musalman khushiyan manayenge. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke Badr ki ladai wale din Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Ibn-e-Abbas, Suddi, Thauri aur Abu Saeed yahi farmate hain. Ek giroh ka khayal hai ke yeh ghalba Hudaibiyah wale saal hua tha, Ikrimah, Zuhri aur Qatadah waghera ka yahi qaul hai. Baaz ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki ke Qaisar-e-Rum ne nazr maani thi ke agar Allah Ta'ala use Fars par ghalib kare ga toh woh is ke shukr mein piyada Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak jaye ga, chunancha us ne apni nazr poori ki aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas pahuncha. Yeh yahin tha aur is ke paas Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka naama-e-mubarak pahuncha jo aap ne Hazrat Dihyah Kalbi (R.A) ki ma'rifat Basra ke governor ko bheja tha aur us ne Heraclius ko pahunchaya tha. Heraclius ne naama-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) paate hi Sham mein jo Hijazi Arab thay unhein apne paas bulaya, un mein Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb Umavi bhi tha aur dusre bhi Quraish ke zi-izzat bade bade log thay. Us ne un sab ko apne samne bitha kar un se poocha ke tum mein se is ka sab se zyada qareebi rishtedar kaun hai? Jis ne nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya hai. Abu Sufyan ne kaha main hoon. Badshah ne unhein aage bitha liya aur un ke sathiyon ko peeche bitha liya aur un se kaha ke dekho main is shakhs se chand sawalat karunga agar yeh kisi sawal ka ghalat jawab de toh tum is ko jhutla dena. Abu Sufyan ka qaul hai ke agar mujhe is baat ka dar na hota ke agar main jhoot bolunga toh log is ko zahir kar denge aur phir is jhoot ko meri taraf nisbat karenge toh yaqeenan main jhoot bolta. Ab Heraclius ne bahut se sawalat kiye. Maslan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hasb-o-nasab, aap ke ausaf-o-aadat ke mutaliq waghera waghera. Un mein ek sawal yeh bhi tha ke kya woh ghaddari karta hai? Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke aaj tak toh kabhi bad-ahdi, wa'da shikni aur ghaddari ki nahin. Is waqt hum mein is mein ek mu'ahida hai, na jaane is mein woh kya kare?

Abu Sufyan ke is qaul se murad Sulh-e-Hudaibiya hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Quraish ke darmiyan yeh baat thehri thi ke aapas mein das saal tak koi ladai na hogi. Yeh waqiya is qaul ki poori daleel ban sakta hai ke Roomi Fars par Hudaibiya wale saal ghalib aaye thay. Is liye ke Qaisar ne apni nazr Hudaibiya ke baad poori ki thi, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin is ka jawab woh log jo kehte hain ke ghalba-e-Room Fars par Badr wale saal hua tha yeh de sakte hain ke chunke mulk ki iqtisadi aur maali halat kharab ho chuki thi, veerani, ghair-abadi wa tang-hali bahut badh gayi thi, is liye chaar saal tak Heraclius ne apni poori tawajjah mulk ki khushhali aur abadi par rakhi. Is ke baad is taraf se itminan hasil karke nazr ko poori karne ke liye rawana hua, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh ikhtilaf koi aisa ahem amr nahin. Haan, Musalman Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hue is liye ke woh kaise hi hon taham thay Ahl-e-Kitab. Aur un ke muqable Majusiyon ki jamaat thi jinhein kitab se door ka talluq bhi na tha. Toh lazmi amr tha ke Musalman un ke ghalbe se na-khush hon aur Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hon. Khud Quran mein maujood hai ke imaan walon ke sab se zyada dushman Yahood aur Mushrik hain aur un se dostiyan rakhne mein sab se zyada qareeb woh log hain jo apne aap ko Nasara kehte hain is liye ke un mein ulama aur darwesh log hain aur yeh mutakabbir nahin, Quran sun kar yeh ro dete hain kyunke haq ko jaan lete hain phir iqrar karte hain ke Aye Allah hum imaan laye toh hamein bhi manne walon mein kar le. Pas yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke Musalman us din khush honge jis din Allah Ta'ala Roomiyon ki madad karega, woh jis ki chahta hai madad karta hai, woh bada ghalib aur bahut meharban hai. Hazrat Zubair Kalami farmate hain main ne Farsiyon ka Roomiyon par ghalib aana, phir Roomiyon ka Farsiyon par ghalib aana, phir Room aur Fars dono par Musalmanon ka ghalib aana apni aankhon se pandrah saal ke andar dekh liya. Aakhir-e-aayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne dushmanon se badla aur inteqam lene par qadir aur apne doston ki khataon aur laghzishon se darguzar farmane wala hai. Jo khabar tumhein di hai ke Roomi anqareeb Farsiyon par ghalib aa jayenge, yeh Allah ki khabar hai, Rabb ka wada hai, Parwardigar ka faisla hai. Namumkin hai ke ghalat nikle, tal jaye ya khilaf ho jaye. Jo haq ke qareeb ho use bhi Rabb haq se bahut door walon par ghalib rakhte hain, haan Allah ki hikmaton ko kam-ilm nahin jaan sakte. Aksar log duniya ka ilm toh khoob rakhte hain, is ki ghutiyan minton mein suljha dete hain, is mein khoob dimagh daudate hain. Is ke bure bhale nuqsan ko pehchan lete hain, ba-ek nigah is ki oonch neech dekh lete hain. Duniya kamane ka, paise jodne ka khoob saleeqa rakhte hain lekin umoor-e-deen mein, ukhrawi kamon mein mehez jahil, ghabi aur kam-fahm hote hain. Yahan na zehan kaam kare na samajh pahunch sake na ghaur-o-fikr ki aadat. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain bahut se aise bhi hain ke namaz tak toh theek padh nahin sakte lekin dirham chutki mein lete hi wazan bata diya karte hain.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki abadi aur raunaq ki toh beesiyon suratein unka zehan ghar leta hai. Lekin deen mein mehez jahil aur aakhirat se bilkul ghafil hain.

Ma'arka-e-Rum-o-Fars ka anjam: Yeh ayatein us waqt nazil huin jabke Neshapur ka Shah-e-Fars bilad-e-Sham aur Jazeerah ke aas-paas ke shehron par ghalib aagaya aur Rum ka badshah Heraclius tang aakar Qustuntuniya mein mahsur hogaya. Muddaton muhasra raha aakhir pansa palta aur Heraclius ki fath hogayi. Mufassal bayan aage aaraha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ke bare mein marwi hai ke Rumiyon ko shikast par shikast hui aur mushrikeen ne is par bahut khushiyan manayin. Is liye ke jaise yeh but-parast thay aise hi Fars wale bhi un se milte-julte thay aur musalmanon ki chahat thi ke Rumi ghalib ayen is liye kam-az-kam woh Ahl-e-Kitab to thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne jab yeh zikr Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Rumi anqareeb phir ghalib aajayenge. Siddiq-e-Akbar ne mushrikeen ko jab yeh khabar pahunchayi to unhon ne kaha aao kuch shart badlo aur muddat muqarrar karlo agar Rumi is muddat mein ghalib na ayen to tum hamain itna-itna dinar dena aur agar tum sachay niklay to hum tumhain itna-itna denge. Paanch saal ki muddat muqarrar hui woh muddat puri hogayi aur Rumi ghalib na aaye to Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne khidmat-e-Nabwi mein yeh khabar pahunchayi, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum ne das saal ki muddat muqarrar kyun na ki. Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain Quran mein muddat ke liye lafz 'biz'a' istemal hua hai aur yeh das se kam par itlaq kiya jata hai chunancha yahi hua bhi ke das saal ke andar-andar Rumi phir ghalib aagaye. Isi ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Imam Tirmidhi ne is hadith ko ghareeb kaha hai. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain ke Badr ki ladai ke baad Rumi bhi Farsiyon par ghalib aagaye. Hazrat Abdullah ka farman hai ke paanch cheezain guzar chuki hain: Dukhan aur Lizam aur Batsha aur Shaq-e-Qamar ka maujiza aur Rumiyon ka ghalib aana. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr ki shart saat saal ki thi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se pucha ke 'biz'a' ke kya ma'ani tum mein hote hain? Jawab diya ke das se kam. Farmaya phir jao muddat mein do saal badha do, chunancha isi muddat ke andar-andar Rumiyon ke ghalib aajane ki khabrain Arab mein pahunch gayin aur musalman khushiyan manane lage. Isi ka bayan in ayaton mein hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke mushrikon ne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar se yeh ayat sun kar kaha ke kya tum is mein bhi apne Nabi ko sacha maante ho? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan. Is par shart thehri aur muddat guzar chuki aur Rumi ghalib na aaye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jab is shart ka ilm hua to Aap (ﷺ) ranjeeda hue aur Janab-e-Siddiq-e-Akbar se farmaya tum ne aisa kyun kiya? Jawab mila ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ki sachayi par bharosa karke. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya phir jao aur muddat mein das saal muqarrar karlo khwah cheez bhi badhani pade. Aap (R.A) gaye, mushrikeen ne dobara yeh muddat badhakar shart manzoor karli. Abhi das saal pooray nahin hue thay ke Rumi Fars par ghalib aagaye aur Madain mein un ke lashkar pahunch gaye aur Rumiyah ki bina unhon ne daal li. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne Quraish se shart ka maal liya aur Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ise sadqa kardo. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqea aisi shart badhne ke haram hone se pehle ka hai.

Is mein hai ke muddat chhay saal muqarrar hui thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab yeh peshan-goi poori hui aur Roomi ghalib aaye toh bahut se mushrikeen imaan bhi le aaye (Tirmidhi). Ek bahut ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissa Imam Junaid ibn Dawood ne apni tafseer mein warid kiya hai ke Ikrama farmate hain Fars mein ek aurat thi jis ke bachay zabardast pehlwan aur badshah hi hotay thay. Kisra ne ek martaba usay bulwaya aur us se kaha ke main Roomiyon par ek lashkar bhejna chahta hoon aur teri aulad mein se kisi ko is lashkar ka sardar banana chahta hoon. Ab tum mashwara kar lo ke kisay sardar banao? Us ne kaha ke mera falan larka toh lomri se zyada makkar aur shakray se zyada hoshiyar hai. Doosra larka Farkhan teer jaisa hai. Teesra larka Shaharbaraz sab se zyada haleem-ul-taba hai. Ab tum jisay chaho sardari do. Badshah ne soch samajh kar Shaharbaraz ko sardar banaya. Yeh lashkaron ko le kar chala Roomiyon se lara bhara aur un par ghalib aa gaya. Un ke lashkar kaat daalay, un ke shehar ujaar diye. Un ke baghaat barbad kar diye, is sarsabz-o-shadab mulk ko veeran-o-gharat kar diya. Aur Azra'at aur Sarrah mein jo Arab ki hudood se miltay hain ek zabardast ma'arka hua. Aur wahan Farsi Roomiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Jis se Quraish khushiyan mananay lagay aur Musalman na-khush huay. Kuffar-e-Quraish Musalmanon ko ta'nay denay lagay ke dekho tum aur Nasrani Ahl-e-Kitab ho aur hum aur Farsi an-parh hain, hamaray walay tumharay walon par ghalib aa gaye. Isi tarah hum bhi tum par ghalib aayenge aur agar larai hui tum hum batla denge ke tum in Ahl-e-Kitab ki tarah hamaray hathon shikast uthao ge. Is par Quran ki yeh aayatein utrin. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) in aayaton ko sun kar mushrikeen ke paas aaye aur farmanay lagay apni is fatah par na utrao, yeh anqareeb shikast se badal jaye gi aur hamaray bhai Ahl-e-Kitab tumharay bhaiyon par ghalib aayenge. Is baat ka yaqeen kar lo is liye ke yeh meri baat nahin balkay hamaray Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh pesh-goi hai. Yeh sun kar Ubay ibn Khalaf khara ho kar kehnay laga ae Abu-ul-Fazl tum jhoot kehtay ho. Aap ne farmaya ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai. Us ne kaha achha main das das oontniyon ki shart badta hoon. Agar teen saal tak Roomi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye toh main tumhein das oontniyan doonga warna tum mujhay dena. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne yeh shart qabool kar li. Phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aa kar is ka zikr kiya toh aap ne kaha main ne tum se teen saal ka nahin kaha tha, 'biz' ka lafz Quran mein hai aur teen se nau tak bola jata hai. Jao oontniyan bhi barha do aur muddat bhi barha do. Hazrat Abu Bakr chalay, jab Ubay ke paas pohanchay toh woh kehnay laga shayad tumhein pachtawa hua? Aap ne farmaya suno main toh pehlay se bhi zyada tayyar ho kar aaya hoon. Aao muddat bhi barhao aur shart ka maal bhi zyada karo. Chunancha ek sau oont muqarrar huay aur nau saal ki muddat thehri, isi muddat mein Roomi Fars par ghalib aa gaye aur Musalman Quraish par chha gaye.

Rumiyon ke ghalbe ka waqia yun hua ke jab Fars ghalib aagaye toh Shahr-e-Baraz ka bhai Farkhan sharab noshi karte hue kehne laga main ne dekha hai ke goya main Kisra ke takht par aagaya hoon aur Fars ka badshah ban gaya hoon. Yeh khabar Kisra ko bhi pahunch gayi. Kisra ne Shahr-e-Baraz ko likha ke mera yeh khat paate hi apne is bhai ko qatl karke iska sar mere paas bhej do. Shahr-e-Baraz ne likha ke ae badshah tum itni jaldi na karo. Farkhan jaisa bahadur sher aur jurrat ke sath dushmanon ke jamghate mein ghusne wala kisi ko tum na paoge. Badshah ne phir jawab likha ke is se bahut zyada aur sher dil pehlwan mere darbar mein ek se behtar ek maujood hain tum is ka gham na karo aur mere hukm ki foran tameel karo. Shahr-e-Baraz ne phir is ka jawab likha aur dobara badshah Kisra ko samjhaya is par badshah aag bagola hogaya us ne elaan kardiya ke Shahr-e-Baraz se main ne sardari chheen li aur is ki jagah is ke bhai Farkhan ko apne lashkar ka sipah salar muqarrar kardiya. Isi mazmoon ka ek khat likh kar qasid ke hamrah Shahr-e-Baraz ko bhej diya ke tum aaj se ma'zool ho aur tum apna ohda Farkhan ko de do. Sath hi qasid ko ek posheeda khat diya ke Shahr-e-Baraz jab apne ohde se utar jaye aur Farkhan is ohde par aajaye toh tum use mera yeh farman de dena. Qasid jab wahan pahuncha toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne khat parhte hi kaha ke mujhe badshah ka hukm manzoor hai, main bakhushi apna ohda Farkhan ko de raha hoon. Farkhan jab takht-e-saltanat par baith gaya aur lashkar ne is ki itaat qabool karli toh qasid ne woh doosra khat Farkhan ke samne pesh kiya jis mein Shahr-e-Baraz ke qatl ka aur is ka sar darbar-e-shahi mein bhejne ka farman tha. Farkhan ne ise parh kar Shahr-e-Baraz ko bulaya aur is ki gardan maarne ka hukm de diya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne kaha badshah jaldi na kar mujhe wasiyat toh likh lene de. Us ne manzoor karliya toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne apna daftar mangwaya aur is mein woh kaghazat jo Shah-e-Kisra ne Farkhan ke qatl ke liye use likhe the woh sab nikale aur Farkhan ke samne pesh kiye aur kaha dekh itne sawal-o-jawab mere aur badshah ke darmiyan tere bare mein hue. Lekin main ne apni aqalmandi se kaam liya aur ajlat na ki, tu ek khat dekhte hi mere qatl par amada hogaya. Zara soch le. In khatoot ko dekh kar Farkhan ki aankhein khul gayin woh foran takht se neeche utar gaya aur apne bhai Shahr-e-Baraz ko phir se malik-e-kul banadiya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne isi waqt Shah-e-Rum Heraclius (Harqal) ko khat likha ke mujhe tum se khufiya mulaqat karni hai aur ek zaroori amr mein mashwara karna hai, ise main na toh kisi qasid ki marifat aap ko kehwa sakta hoon na khat mein likh sakta hoon. Balkeh main khud hi aamne samne pesh karunga. Pachas aadmi apne sath le kar khud aajaye aur pachas hi mere sath honge. Qaisar ko jab yeh paigham pahuncha toh woh is se mulaqat ke liye chal para. Lekin ehtiyatan apne sath paanch hazar sawar le liye.

Aur aage aage jasuson ko bhej diya taake koi makr ya fareb ho toh khul jaye. Jasuson ne aakar khabar di ke koi baat nahin aur Shahrbaraz tanha apne saath sirf pachaas sawaron ko lekar aaya hai, uske saath koi aur nahin. Chunancha Qaisar ne bhi mutma'in ho kar apne sawaron ko lota diya aur apne saath sirf pachaas aadmi rakh liye. Jo jagah mulaqat ki muqarrar hui thi wahan pahunch gaye. Wahan ek reshmi qubba tha, us mein jakar dono tanha baith gaye, pachaas pachaas aadmi alag chhod diye gaye, dono wahan be-hathiyar thay sirf chhuriyan paas thin aur dono ki taraf se ek tarjuman saath tha. Khaime mein pahunch kar Shahrbaraz ne kaha, "Ae Badshah-e-Rum! Baat yeh hai ke tumhare mulk ko veeran karne wale aur tumhare lashkaron ko shikast dene wale hum dono bhai hain, humne apni chalakiyon aur shuja'at se yeh mulk apne qabze mein kar liya hai. Lekin ab hamara badshah Kisra hamara hasad karta hai aur hamara mukhalif ban baitha hai, mujhe usne mere bhai ko qatl karne ka farman bheja, maine farman ko na mana toh usne ab yeh tay kar liya hai ke hum aapke lashkar mein aa jayen aur Kisra ke lashkaron se aapke saath ho kar ladein." Qaisar ne yeh baat badi khushi se manzoor kar li. Phir un dono mein aapas mein isharon kinayon se baatein huin jin ka matlab yeh tha ke yeh dono tarjuman qatl kar diye jayen, aisa na ho ke yeh raaz unki wajah se khul jaye kyunke jahan do ke siwa teesre ke kaan mein koi baat pahunchi toh phir woh phail jati hai. Dono is par ittefaq karke khade ho gaye aur har ek ne apne tarjuman ka kaam tamam kar diya. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne Kisra ko halak kar diya aur Hudaibiya wale din uski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko mili, Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) is se bahut khush hue. Yeh siyaq ajeeb hai aur yeh khabar ghareeb hai. Ab aayat ke alfaaz ke mutaliq suniye. Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein hote hain unki behas toh hum kar chuke hain, Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein dekh lijiye. Roomi sab ke sab 'Iys bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim ki nasl se hain, Bani Israel ke chacha zaad bhai hain. Roomiyon ko Banu Asfar bhi kehte hain, yeh Yunaniyon ke mazhab par thay, Yunani Yafis bin Nuh ki aulad mein hain, Turkon ke chacha zaad bhai hote hain, yeh sitara parast thay, saaton sitaron ko maante aur poojte thay. Inhein Mutahayyira bhi kaha jata hai, yeh Qutb-e-Shamali ko qibla maante thay. Damishq ki bina inhi ke hathon padi, wahin unhone apni ibadat-gah banayi jis ke mehrab shumal ki taraf hain. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki nabuwwat ke baad bhi teen sau saal tak Roomi apne purane khayalat par hi rahe, un mein se jo koi Sham ka aur Jazeere ka badshah ho jata use Qaisar kaha jata tha. Sab se pehle Roomiyon ka badshah Qustuntin bin Qustus ne Nasrani mazhab qabool kiya. Uski maa ka naam Maryam tha, Hailaniya Ghunduqaniya thi, Harran ki rehne wali. Pehle isi ne Nasraniyat qabool ki thi, phir uske kehne sunne se uske bete ne bhi yahi mazhab ikhtiyar kar liya. Yeh bada falsafi, aqalmand aur makkar aadmi tha.

Yeh bhi mashhoor hai ke us ne darasal dil se is mazhab ko nahin mana tha. Us ke zamane mein Nasrani jama hogaye. Un mein aapas mein mazhabi chher-chhar aur ikhtilaf aur munazire chhir gaye. Abdullah bin Arius se bade bade munazire hue aur is qadar intishar aur tafreeq hui ke bayan se bahar hai. Teen sau athara padriyon ne mil kar ek kitab likhi jo badshah ko di gayi aur woh shahi aqeeda tasleem ki gayi. Isi ko Amanat-e-Kubra kaha jata hai, jo darhaqiqat Khayanat-e-Sughra hai. Yehin fiqhi kitabein isi ke zamane mein likhi gayin. Un mein halal haram ke masail bayan kiye gaye aur un ke ulama ne dil khol kar jo chaha un mein likha. Jis qadar ji mein aayi kami ya ziyadati asal deen-e-Masih mein ki aur asal mazhab muharraf-o-mubaddal hogaya. Mashriq ki janib namazein padhne lage. Bajaye hafta ke itwar ko bada din banaya. Saleeb ki parastish shuru hogayi. Khanzeer ko halal kar liya gaya aur bahut se tehwar ijad kar liye jaise Eid-e-Saleeb, Eid-e-Quds, Eid-e-Ghatas waghera waghera. Phir un ulama ke silsile qaim kiye gaye, ek to bada padri hota tha phir us ke neeche darja badarja aur mehkame hote thay. Rahbaniyat aur tark-e-duniya ki bid'at bhi ijad kar li. Kaleesa aur girje bahut sare bana liye gaye aur shehar Qustuntuniya ki bina rakhi gayi aur is bade shehar ko isi badshah ke naam par namzad kiya gaya. Is badshah ne barah hazar girje bana diye. Teen mehrabon se Bait-ul-Lahm bana. Us ki maa ne bhi Qumama banaya. In logon ko Malkiya kehte hain is liye ke yeh log apne badshah ke deen par thay. In ke baad Ya'qubiya phir Nasturiya. Yeh sab Nastur ke muqallid thay. Phir un ke bahut se giroh thay jaise hadith mein hai ke un ke bahattar (72) firqe hogaye. Un ki saltanat barabar chali aati thi, ek ke baad ek Qaisar hona aata tha yahan tak ke aakhir mein Qaisar Heraclius (Harqal) hua. Yeh tamam badshahon se ziyada aqalmand tha, bahut bada aalim tha, danai, ziraki, door-andeshi aur door-beeni mein apna sani nahin rakhta tha. Us ne saltanat bahut wasee kar li aur mamlikat door-daraz tak phaila di. Us ke muqable mein Fars ka badshah Kisra khada hua aur chhoti chhoti saltanaton ne bhi us ka sath diya, us ki saltanat Qaisar se bhi ziyada badi thi. Yeh Majusi log thay, aag ko poojte thay. Mandarja bala riwayat mein to hai ke us ka sipah salar muqable par gaya lekin mashhoor baat yeh hai ke khud Kisra us ke muqable par gaya. Qaisar ko shikast hui yahan tak ke woh Qustuntuniya mein ghir gaya. Nasrani us ki badi izzat aur ta'zeem karte thay, go Kisra lambi muddat tak muhasra kiye pada raha lekin dar-us-saltanat ko fath na kar saka. Ek wajah yeh bhi thi ke us ka mulk nisf samundar ki taraf tha aur nisf khushki ki taraf tha, to Shah-e-Qaisar ko kumak aur rasad tari ke raste se barabar pahunchti rahi. Aakhir mein Qaisar ne ek chaal chali, us ne Kisra ko kehwa bheja ke aap jo chahein mujh se tasalli le lijiye aur jin sharait par chahein mujh se sulah kar lijiye. Kisra us par raazi hogaya aur itna maal talab kiya ke woh aur yeh mil kar bhi jama karna chahein to namumkin tha.

Qaisar ne ise qabool kar liya kyunke usne is se Kisra ki bewaqoofi ka pata chala liya ke yeh woh cheez maangta hai jis ka jama karna duniya ke ikhtiyar se bahar hai, balkay saari duniya mil kar is ka daswan hissa bhi jama nahin kar sakti. Qaisar ne Kisra se kehlwa bheja ke mujhe ijazat de ke main apne mulk se bahar chal phir kar is daulat ko jama kar loon aur aap ko sonp doon. Usne yeh darkhwast manzoor kar li. Ab Shah-e-Room ne apne lashkar ko jama kiya aur un se kaha main ek zaroori aur ahem kaam ke liye apne makhsoos ahbab ke sath ja raha hoon. Agar ek saal ke andar andar aa jaoon to yeh mulk mera hai warna tumhein ikhtiyar hai jise chaho apna badshah tasleem kar lena. Unhon ne jawab diya ke hamare badshah to aap hi hain khwah das saal tak bhi aap na lautay to kya hua. Yeh yahan se mukhtasar si janbaz jamaat le kar chup chap chal khara hua. Posheeda raston se nihayat hoshiyari, ehtiyat aur chalaki se bohat jald Fars ke shehron tak pahunch gaya aur yak-a-yak dhawa bol diya, chunke yahan ki faujein to Room pahunch chuki thin, awam kahan tak muqabla karte. Usne qatl-e-aam shuru kiya. Jo samne aaya talwar ke kaam aaya, yunhi barhta chala gaya yahan tak ke Madain pahunch gaya jo Kisra ki saltanat ki kursi thi, wahan ki muhafiz fauj par bhi ghalib aaya, unhein bhi qatl kar diya aur charon taraf se maal jama kiya. Un ki tamam aurton ko qaid kar liya aur tamam larne walon ko qatl kar dala. Kisra ke larkay ko zinda giraftar kiya, us mehal-e-saraye ki aurton ko zinda giraftar kiya. Us ki darbardari aurtein waghera bhi pakri gayin, uske lashkar ka sar mundwa kar gadhay par bitha kar aurton samet Kisra ki taraf bheja ke lijiye jo maal aur aurtein aur ghulam tu ne mangay thay woh sab hazir hain. Jab yeh qafila Kisra ke paas pahuncha, Kisra ko sakht sadma hua. Yeh abhi tak Qustuntuniya ka muhasra kiye para tha aur Qaisar ki wapsi ka intezar kar raha tha ke us ke paas us ka kul khandan aur saari haram-sara is zillat ki halat mein pahunchi. Yeh sakht ghazabnak hua aur shehar par bohat sakht hamla kar diya lekin is mein koi kamyabi na hui. Ab yeh nehar-e-Jaihoon ki taraf chala ke Qaisar ko wahan rok le kyunke Qaisar ka Fars se Qustuntuniya aanay ka rasta yahi tha. Qaisar ne ise sun kar pehle se bhi zabardast hamla kiya, yani usne apne lashkar ko to darya ke is dahane chora aur khud thoray se aadmi le kar sawar ho kar pani ke bahao ki taraf chal diya. Koi ek din raat ka rasta chalne ke baad apne sath jo kayi chara, leed, gobar waghera le gaya tha use pani mein baha diya. Yeh cheezein pani mein behti hui Kisra ke lashkar ke paas se guzrin to woh samajh gaye ke Qaisar yahan se guzar gaya hai. Yeh us ke lashkaron ke janwaron ke aasar hain. Ab Qaisar wapas apne lashkar mein pahunch gaya, udhar Kisra us ki talash mein aagay chala gaya. Qaisar apne lashkaron samet Jaihoon ka dahana aboor kar ke rasta badal kar Qustuntuniya pahunch gaya. Jis din yeh apne dar-us-saltanat mein pahuncha, Nasraniyon mein bari khushiyan manayi gayin.

Kisra ko jab yeh ittila hui toh us ka ajab haal hua ke na paye mandan na jaye raftan, na toh Rum hi fath hua aur na Fars hi raha. Rumi ghalib aa gaye, Fars ki auratein aur wahan ke maal un ke qabze mein aaye. Yeh kul umoor nau saal mein hue aur Rumiyon ne apni khoi hui saltanat Farsiyon se dobara le li aur maghloob ho kar ghalib aa gaye. Azra'at aur Basra ke ma'arke mein Ahl-e-Fars ghalib aa gaye thay aur yeh mulk-e-Sham ka woh hissa tha jo Hijaz se milta tha, yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh hazimat Jazeerah mein hui thi jo Rumiyon ki sarhad ka maqam hai aur Fars se milta hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir nau saal ke andar andar Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Quran-e-Kareem mein lafz 'biz' ka hai aur is ka itlaq bhi nau tak hota hai aur yahi tafseer is lafz ki Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Jarir wali hadith mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se farmaya tha ke tumhein ehtiyatan das saal tak rakhne chahiye thay kyunke 'biz' ke lafz ka itlaq teen se nau tak hota hai. Is ke baad qabl aur ba'd par pesh izafat hata dene ki wajah hai ke is ke baad hukm Allah hi ka hai. Us din jab ke Rum Fars par ghalib aa jaye ga toh Musalman khushiyan manayenge. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke Badr ki ladai wale din Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Ibn-e-Abbas, Suddi, Thauri aur Abu Saeed yahi farmate hain. Ek giroh ka khayal hai ke yeh ghalba Hudaibiyah wale saal hua tha, Ikrimah, Zuhri aur Qatadah waghera ka yahi qaul hai. Baaz ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki ke Qaisar-e-Rum ne nazr maani thi ke agar Allah Ta'ala use Fars par ghalib kare ga toh woh is ke shukr mein piyada Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak jaye ga, chunancha us ne apni nazr poori ki aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas pahuncha. Yeh yahin tha aur is ke paas Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka naama-e-mubarak pahuncha jo aap ne Hazrat Dihyah Kalbi (R.A) ki ma'rifat Basra ke governor ko bheja tha aur us ne Heraclius ko pahunchaya tha. Heraclius ne naama-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) paate hi Sham mein jo Hijazi Arab thay unhein apne paas bulaya, un mein Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb Umavi bhi tha aur dusre bhi Quraish ke zi-izzat bade bade log thay. Us ne un sab ko apne samne bitha kar un se poocha ke tum mein se is ka sab se zyada qareebi rishtedar kaun hai? Jis ne nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya hai. Abu Sufyan ne kaha main hoon. Badshah ne unhein aage bitha liya aur un ke sathiyon ko peeche bitha liya aur un se kaha ke dekho main is shakhs se chand sawalat karunga agar yeh kisi sawal ka ghalat jawab de toh tum is ko jhutla dena. Abu Sufyan ka qaul hai ke agar mujhe is baat ka dar na hota ke agar main jhoot bolunga toh log is ko zahir kar denge aur phir is jhoot ko meri taraf nisbat karenge toh yaqeenan main jhoot bolta. Ab Heraclius ne bahut se sawalat kiye. Maslan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hasb-o-nasab, aap ke ausaf-o-aadat ke mutaliq waghera waghera. Un mein ek sawal yeh bhi tha ke kya woh ghaddari karta hai? Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke aaj tak toh kabhi bad-ahdi, wa'da shikni aur ghaddari ki nahin. Is waqt hum mein is mein ek mu'ahida hai, na jaane is mein woh kya kare?

Abu Sufyan ke is qaul se murad Sulh-e-Hudaibiya hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Quraish ke darmiyan yeh baat thehri thi ke aapas mein das saal tak koi ladai na hogi. Yeh waqiya is qaul ki poori daleel ban sakta hai ke Roomi Fars par Hudaibiya wale saal ghalib aaye thay. Is liye ke Qaisar ne apni nazr Hudaibiya ke baad poori ki thi, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin is ka jawab woh log jo kehte hain ke ghalba-e-Room Fars par Badr wale saal hua tha yeh de sakte hain ke chunke mulk ki iqtisadi aur maali halat kharab ho chuki thi, veerani, ghair-abadi wa tang-hali bahut badh gayi thi, is liye chaar saal tak Heraclius ne apni poori tawajjah mulk ki khushhali aur abadi par rakhi. Is ke baad is taraf se itminan hasil karke nazr ko poori karne ke liye rawana hua, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh ikhtilaf koi aisa ahem amr nahin. Haan, Musalman Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hue is liye ke woh kaise hi hon taham thay Ahl-e-Kitab. Aur un ke muqable Majusiyon ki jamaat thi jinhein kitab se door ka talluq bhi na tha. Toh lazmi amr tha ke Musalman un ke ghalbe se na-khush hon aur Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hon. Khud Quran mein maujood hai ke imaan walon ke sab se zyada dushman Yahood aur Mushrik hain aur un se dostiyan rakhne mein sab se zyada qareeb woh log hain jo apne aap ko Nasara kehte hain is liye ke un mein ulama aur darwesh log hain aur yeh mutakabbir nahin, Quran sun kar yeh ro dete hain kyunke haq ko jaan lete hain phir iqrar karte hain ke Aye Allah hum imaan laye toh hamein bhi manne walon mein kar le. Pas yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke Musalman us din khush honge jis din Allah Ta'ala Roomiyon ki madad karega, woh jis ki chahta hai madad karta hai, woh bada ghalib aur bahut meharban hai. Hazrat Zubair Kalami farmate hain main ne Farsiyon ka Roomiyon par ghalib aana, phir Roomiyon ka Farsiyon par ghalib aana, phir Room aur Fars dono par Musalmanon ka ghalib aana apni aankhon se pandrah saal ke andar dekh liya. Aakhir-e-aayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne dushmanon se badla aur inteqam lene par qadir aur apne doston ki khataon aur laghzishon se darguzar farmane wala hai. Jo khabar tumhein di hai ke Roomi anqareeb Farsiyon par ghalib aa jayenge, yeh Allah ki khabar hai, Rabb ka wada hai, Parwardigar ka faisla hai. Namumkin hai ke ghalat nikle, tal jaye ya khilaf ho jaye. Jo haq ke qareeb ho use bhi Rabb haq se bahut door walon par ghalib rakhte hain, haan Allah ki hikmaton ko kam-ilm nahin jaan sakte. Aksar log duniya ka ilm toh khoob rakhte hain, is ki ghutiyan minton mein suljha dete hain, is mein khoob dimagh daudate hain. Is ke bure bhale nuqsan ko pehchan lete hain, ba-ek nigah is ki oonch neech dekh lete hain. Duniya kamane ka, paise jodne ka khoob saleeqa rakhte hain lekin umoor-e-deen mein, ukhrawi kamon mein mehez jahil, ghabi aur kam-fahm hote hain. Yahan na zehan kaam kare na samajh pahunch sake na ghaur-o-fikr ki aadat. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain bahut se aise bhi hain ke namaz tak toh theek padh nahin sakte lekin dirham chutki mein lete hi wazan bata diya karte hain.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki abadi aur raunaq ki toh beesiyon suratein unka zehan ghar leta hai. Lekin deen mein mehez jahil aur aakhirat se bilkul ghafil hain.

Ma'arka-e-Rum-o-Fars ka anjam: Yeh ayatein us waqt nazil huin jabke Neshapur ka Shah-e-Fars bilad-e-Sham aur Jazeerah ke aas-paas ke shehron par ghalib aagaya aur Rum ka badshah Heraclius tang aakar Qustuntuniya mein mahsur hogaya. Muddaton muhasra raha aakhir pansa palta aur Heraclius ki fath hogayi. Mufassal bayan aage aaraha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is ayat ke bare mein marwi hai ke Rumiyon ko shikast par shikast hui aur mushrikeen ne is par bahut khushiyan manayin. Is liye ke jaise yeh but-parast thay aise hi Fars wale bhi un se milte-julte thay aur musalmanon ki chahat thi ke Rumi ghalib ayen is liye kam-az-kam woh Ahl-e-Kitab to thay. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne jab yeh zikr Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Rumi anqareeb phir ghalib aajayenge. Siddiq-e-Akbar ne mushrikeen ko jab yeh khabar pahunchayi to unhon ne kaha aao kuch shart badlo aur muddat muqarrar karlo agar Rumi is muddat mein ghalib na ayen to tum hamain itna-itna dinar dena aur agar tum sachay niklay to hum tumhain itna-itna denge. Paanch saal ki muddat muqarrar hui woh muddat puri hogayi aur Rumi ghalib na aaye to Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne khidmat-e-Nabwi mein yeh khabar pahunchayi, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum ne das saal ki muddat muqarrar kyun na ki. Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain Quran mein muddat ke liye lafz 'biz'a' istemal hua hai aur yeh das se kam par itlaq kiya jata hai chunancha yahi hua bhi ke das saal ke andar-andar Rumi phir ghalib aagaye. Isi ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Imam Tirmidhi ne is hadith ko ghareeb kaha hai. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain ke Badr ki ladai ke baad Rumi bhi Farsiyon par ghalib aagaye. Hazrat Abdullah ka farman hai ke paanch cheezain guzar chuki hain: Dukhan aur Lizam aur Batsha aur Shaq-e-Qamar ka maujiza aur Rumiyon ka ghalib aana. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr ki shart saat saal ki thi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un se pucha ke 'biz'a' ke kya ma'ani tum mein hote hain? Jawab diya ke das se kam. Farmaya phir jao muddat mein do saal badha do, chunancha isi muddat ke andar-andar Rumiyon ke ghalib aajane ki khabrain Arab mein pahunch gayin aur musalman khushiyan manane lage. Isi ka bayan in ayaton mein hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke mushrikon ne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar se yeh ayat sun kar kaha ke kya tum is mein bhi apne Nabi ko sacha maante ho? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan. Is par shart thehri aur muddat guzar chuki aur Rumi ghalib na aaye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ko jab is shart ka ilm hua to Aap (ﷺ) ranjeeda hue aur Janab-e-Siddiq-e-Akbar se farmaya tum ne aisa kyun kiya? Jawab mila ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ki sachayi par bharosa karke. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya phir jao aur muddat mein das saal muqarrar karlo khwah cheez bhi badhani pade. Aap (R.A) gaye, mushrikeen ne dobara yeh muddat badhakar shart manzoor karli. Abhi das saal pooray nahin hue thay ke Rumi Fars par ghalib aagaye aur Madain mein un ke lashkar pahunch gaye aur Rumiyah ki bina unhon ne daal li. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne Quraish se shart ka maal liya aur Hazrat (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ise sadqa kardo. Aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh waqea aisi shart badhne ke haram hone se pehle ka hai.

Is mein hai ke muddat chhay saal muqarrar hui thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab yeh peshan-goi poori hui aur Roomi ghalib aaye toh bahut se mushrikeen imaan bhi le aaye (Tirmidhi). Ek bahut ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissa Imam Junaid ibn Dawood ne apni tafseer mein warid kiya hai ke Ikrama farmate hain Fars mein ek aurat thi jis ke bachay zabardast pehlwan aur badshah hi hotay thay. Kisra ne ek martaba usay bulwaya aur us se kaha ke main Roomiyon par ek lashkar bhejna chahta hoon aur teri aulad mein se kisi ko is lashkar ka sardar banana chahta hoon. Ab tum mashwara kar lo ke kisay sardar banao? Us ne kaha ke mera falan larka toh lomri se zyada makkar aur shakray se zyada hoshiyar hai. Doosra larka Farkhan teer jaisa hai. Teesra larka Shaharbaraz sab se zyada haleem-ul-taba hai. Ab tum jisay chaho sardari do. Badshah ne soch samajh kar Shaharbaraz ko sardar banaya. Yeh lashkaron ko le kar chala Roomiyon se lara bhara aur un par ghalib aa gaya. Un ke lashkar kaat daalay, un ke shehar ujaar diye. Un ke baghaat barbad kar diye, is sarsabz-o-shadab mulk ko veeran-o-gharat kar diya. Aur Azra'at aur Sarrah mein jo Arab ki hudood se miltay hain ek zabardast ma'arka hua. Aur wahan Farsi Roomiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Jis se Quraish khushiyan mananay lagay aur Musalman na-khush huay. Kuffar-e-Quraish Musalmanon ko ta'nay denay lagay ke dekho tum aur Nasrani Ahl-e-Kitab ho aur hum aur Farsi an-parh hain, hamaray walay tumharay walon par ghalib aa gaye. Isi tarah hum bhi tum par ghalib aayenge aur agar larai hui tum hum batla denge ke tum in Ahl-e-Kitab ki tarah hamaray hathon shikast uthao ge. Is par Quran ki yeh aayatein utrin. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) in aayaton ko sun kar mushrikeen ke paas aaye aur farmanay lagay apni is fatah par na utrao, yeh anqareeb shikast se badal jaye gi aur hamaray bhai Ahl-e-Kitab tumharay bhaiyon par ghalib aayenge. Is baat ka yaqeen kar lo is liye ke yeh meri baat nahin balkay hamaray Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh pesh-goi hai. Yeh sun kar Ubay ibn Khalaf khara ho kar kehnay laga ae Abu-ul-Fazl tum jhoot kehtay ho. Aap ne farmaya ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai. Us ne kaha achha main das das oontniyon ki shart badta hoon. Agar teen saal tak Roomi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye toh main tumhein das oontniyan doonga warna tum mujhay dena. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne yeh shart qabool kar li. Phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aa kar is ka zikr kiya toh aap ne kaha main ne tum se teen saal ka nahin kaha tha, 'biz' ka lafz Quran mein hai aur teen se nau tak bola jata hai. Jao oontniyan bhi barha do aur muddat bhi barha do. Hazrat Abu Bakr chalay, jab Ubay ke paas pohanchay toh woh kehnay laga shayad tumhein pachtawa hua? Aap ne farmaya suno main toh pehlay se bhi zyada tayyar ho kar aaya hoon. Aao muddat bhi barhao aur shart ka maal bhi zyada karo. Chunancha ek sau oont muqarrar huay aur nau saal ki muddat thehri, isi muddat mein Roomi Fars par ghalib aa gaye aur Musalman Quraish par chha gaye.

Rumiyon ke ghalbe ka waqia yun hua ke jab Fars ghalib aagaye toh Shahr-e-Baraz ka bhai Farkhan sharab noshi karte hue kehne laga main ne dekha hai ke goya main Kisra ke takht par aagaya hoon aur Fars ka badshah ban gaya hoon. Yeh khabar Kisra ko bhi pahunch gayi. Kisra ne Shahr-e-Baraz ko likha ke mera yeh khat paate hi apne is bhai ko qatl karke iska sar mere paas bhej do. Shahr-e-Baraz ne likha ke ae badshah tum itni jaldi na karo. Farkhan jaisa bahadur sher aur jurrat ke sath dushmanon ke jamghate mein ghusne wala kisi ko tum na paoge. Badshah ne phir jawab likha ke is se bahut zyada aur sher dil pehlwan mere darbar mein ek se behtar ek maujood hain tum is ka gham na karo aur mere hukm ki foran tameel karo. Shahr-e-Baraz ne phir is ka jawab likha aur dobara badshah Kisra ko samjhaya is par badshah aag bagola hogaya us ne elaan kardiya ke Shahr-e-Baraz se main ne sardari chheen li aur is ki jagah is ke bhai Farkhan ko apne lashkar ka sipah salar muqarrar kardiya. Isi mazmoon ka ek khat likh kar qasid ke hamrah Shahr-e-Baraz ko bhej diya ke tum aaj se ma'zool ho aur tum apna ohda Farkhan ko de do. Sath hi qasid ko ek posheeda khat diya ke Shahr-e-Baraz jab apne ohde se utar jaye aur Farkhan is ohde par aajaye toh tum use mera yeh farman de dena. Qasid jab wahan pahuncha toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne khat parhte hi kaha ke mujhe badshah ka hukm manzoor hai, main bakhushi apna ohda Farkhan ko de raha hoon. Farkhan jab takht-e-saltanat par baith gaya aur lashkar ne is ki itaat qabool karli toh qasid ne woh doosra khat Farkhan ke samne pesh kiya jis mein Shahr-e-Baraz ke qatl ka aur is ka sar darbar-e-shahi mein bhejne ka farman tha. Farkhan ne ise parh kar Shahr-e-Baraz ko bulaya aur is ki gardan maarne ka hukm de diya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne kaha badshah jaldi na kar mujhe wasiyat toh likh lene de. Us ne manzoor karliya toh Shahr-e-Baraz ne apna daftar mangwaya aur is mein woh kaghazat jo Shah-e-Kisra ne Farkhan ke qatl ke liye use likhe the woh sab nikale aur Farkhan ke samne pesh kiye aur kaha dekh itne sawal-o-jawab mere aur badshah ke darmiyan tere bare mein hue. Lekin main ne apni aqalmandi se kaam liya aur ajlat na ki, tu ek khat dekhte hi mere qatl par amada hogaya. Zara soch le. In khatoot ko dekh kar Farkhan ki aankhein khul gayin woh foran takht se neeche utar gaya aur apne bhai Shahr-e-Baraz ko phir se malik-e-kul banadiya. Shahr-e-Baraz ne isi waqt Shah-e-Rum Heraclius (Harqal) ko khat likha ke mujhe tum se khufiya mulaqat karni hai aur ek zaroori amr mein mashwara karna hai, ise main na toh kisi qasid ki marifat aap ko kehwa sakta hoon na khat mein likh sakta hoon. Balkeh main khud hi aamne samne pesh karunga. Pachas aadmi apne sath le kar khud aajaye aur pachas hi mere sath honge. Qaisar ko jab yeh paigham pahuncha toh woh is se mulaqat ke liye chal para. Lekin ehtiyatan apne sath paanch hazar sawar le liye.

Aur aage aage jasuson ko bhej diya taake koi makr ya fareb ho toh khul jaye. Jasuson ne aakar khabar di ke koi baat nahin aur Shahrbaraz tanha apne saath sirf pachaas sawaron ko lekar aaya hai, uske saath koi aur nahin. Chunancha Qaisar ne bhi mutma'in ho kar apne sawaron ko lota diya aur apne saath sirf pachaas aadmi rakh liye. Jo jagah mulaqat ki muqarrar hui thi wahan pahunch gaye. Wahan ek reshmi qubba tha, us mein jakar dono tanha baith gaye, pachaas pachaas aadmi alag chhod diye gaye, dono wahan be-hathiyar thay sirf chhuriyan paas thin aur dono ki taraf se ek tarjuman saath tha. Khaime mein pahunch kar Shahrbaraz ne kaha, "Ae Badshah-e-Rum! Baat yeh hai ke tumhare mulk ko veeran karne wale aur tumhare lashkaron ko shikast dene wale hum dono bhai hain, humne apni chalakiyon aur shuja'at se yeh mulk apne qabze mein kar liya hai. Lekin ab hamara badshah Kisra hamara hasad karta hai aur hamara mukhalif ban baitha hai, mujhe usne mere bhai ko qatl karne ka farman bheja, maine farman ko na mana toh usne ab yeh tay kar liya hai ke hum aapke lashkar mein aa jayen aur Kisra ke lashkaron se aapke saath ho kar ladein." Qaisar ne yeh baat badi khushi se manzoor kar li. Phir un dono mein aapas mein isharon kinayon se baatein huin jin ka matlab yeh tha ke yeh dono tarjuman qatl kar diye jayen, aisa na ho ke yeh raaz unki wajah se khul jaye kyunke jahan do ke siwa teesre ke kaan mein koi baat pahunchi toh phir woh phail jati hai. Dono is par ittefaq karke khade ho gaye aur har ek ne apne tarjuman ka kaam tamam kar diya. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne Kisra ko halak kar diya aur Hudaibiya wale din uski khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko mili, Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) is se bahut khush hue. Yeh siyaq ajeeb hai aur yeh khabar ghareeb hai. Ab aayat ke alfaaz ke mutaliq suniye. Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein hote hain unki behas toh hum kar chuke hain, Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein dekh lijiye. Roomi sab ke sab 'Iys bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim ki nasl se hain, Bani Israel ke chacha zaad bhai hain. Roomiyon ko Banu Asfar bhi kehte hain, yeh Yunaniyon ke mazhab par thay, Yunani Yafis bin Nuh ki aulad mein hain, Turkon ke chacha zaad bhai hote hain, yeh sitara parast thay, saaton sitaron ko maante aur poojte thay. Inhein Mutahayyira bhi kaha jata hai, yeh Qutb-e-Shamali ko qibla maante thay. Damishq ki bina inhi ke hathon padi, wahin unhone apni ibadat-gah banayi jis ke mehrab shumal ki taraf hain. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki nabuwwat ke baad bhi teen sau saal tak Roomi apne purane khayalat par hi rahe, un mein se jo koi Sham ka aur Jazeere ka badshah ho jata use Qaisar kaha jata tha. Sab se pehle Roomiyon ka badshah Qustuntin bin Qustus ne Nasrani mazhab qabool kiya. Uski maa ka naam Maryam tha, Hailaniya Ghunduqaniya thi, Harran ki rehne wali. Pehle isi ne Nasraniyat qabool ki thi, phir uske kehne sunne se uske bete ne bhi yahi mazhab ikhtiyar kar liya. Yeh bada falsafi, aqalmand aur makkar aadmi tha.

Yeh bhi mashhoor hai ke us ne darasal dil se is mazhab ko nahin mana tha. Us ke zamane mein Nasrani jama hogaye. Un mein aapas mein mazhabi chher-chhar aur ikhtilaf aur munazire chhir gaye. Abdullah bin Arius se bade bade munazire hue aur is qadar intishar aur tafreeq hui ke bayan se bahar hai. Teen sau athara padriyon ne mil kar ek kitab likhi jo badshah ko di gayi aur woh shahi aqeeda tasleem ki gayi. Isi ko Amanat-e-Kubra kaha jata hai, jo darhaqiqat Khayanat-e-Sughra hai. Yehin fiqhi kitabein isi ke zamane mein likhi gayin. Un mein halal haram ke masail bayan kiye gaye aur un ke ulama ne dil khol kar jo chaha un mein likha. Jis qadar ji mein aayi kami ya ziyadati asal deen-e-Masih mein ki aur asal mazhab muharraf-o-mubaddal hogaya. Mashriq ki janib namazein padhne lage. Bajaye hafta ke itwar ko bada din banaya. Saleeb ki parastish shuru hogayi. Khanzeer ko halal kar liya gaya aur bahut se tehwar ijad kar liye jaise Eid-e-Saleeb, Eid-e-Quds, Eid-e-Ghatas waghera waghera. Phir un ulama ke silsile qaim kiye gaye, ek to bada padri hota tha phir us ke neeche darja badarja aur mehkame hote thay. Rahbaniyat aur tark-e-duniya ki bid'at bhi ijad kar li. Kaleesa aur girje bahut sare bana liye gaye aur shehar Qustuntuniya ki bina rakhi gayi aur is bade shehar ko isi badshah ke naam par namzad kiya gaya. Is badshah ne barah hazar girje bana diye. Teen mehrabon se Bait-ul-Lahm bana. Us ki maa ne bhi Qumama banaya. In logon ko Malkiya kehte hain is liye ke yeh log apne badshah ke deen par thay. In ke baad Ya'qubiya phir Nasturiya. Yeh sab Nastur ke muqallid thay. Phir un ke bahut se giroh thay jaise hadith mein hai ke un ke bahattar (72) firqe hogaye. Un ki saltanat barabar chali aati thi, ek ke baad ek Qaisar hona aata tha yahan tak ke aakhir mein Qaisar Heraclius (Harqal) hua. Yeh tamam badshahon se ziyada aqalmand tha, bahut bada aalim tha, danai, ziraki, door-andeshi aur door-beeni mein apna sani nahin rakhta tha. Us ne saltanat bahut wasee kar li aur mamlikat door-daraz tak phaila di. Us ke muqable mein Fars ka badshah Kisra khada hua aur chhoti chhoti saltanaton ne bhi us ka sath diya, us ki saltanat Qaisar se bhi ziyada badi thi. Yeh Majusi log thay, aag ko poojte thay. Mandarja bala riwayat mein to hai ke us ka sipah salar muqable par gaya lekin mashhoor baat yeh hai ke khud Kisra us ke muqable par gaya. Qaisar ko shikast hui yahan tak ke woh Qustuntuniya mein ghir gaya. Nasrani us ki badi izzat aur ta'zeem karte thay, go Kisra lambi muddat tak muhasra kiye pada raha lekin dar-us-saltanat ko fath na kar saka. Ek wajah yeh bhi thi ke us ka mulk nisf samundar ki taraf tha aur nisf khushki ki taraf tha, to Shah-e-Qaisar ko kumak aur rasad tari ke raste se barabar pahunchti rahi. Aakhir mein Qaisar ne ek chaal chali, us ne Kisra ko kehwa bheja ke aap jo chahein mujh se tasalli le lijiye aur jin sharait par chahein mujh se sulah kar lijiye. Kisra us par raazi hogaya aur itna maal talab kiya ke woh aur yeh mil kar bhi jama karna chahein to namumkin tha.

Qaisar ne ise qabool kar liya kyunke usne is se Kisra ki bewaqoofi ka pata chala liya ke yeh woh cheez maangta hai jis ka jama karna duniya ke ikhtiyar se bahar hai, balkay saari duniya mil kar is ka daswan hissa bhi jama nahin kar sakti. Qaisar ne Kisra se kehlwa bheja ke mujhe ijazat de ke main apne mulk se bahar chal phir kar is daulat ko jama kar loon aur aap ko sonp doon. Usne yeh darkhwast manzoor kar li. Ab Shah-e-Room ne apne lashkar ko jama kiya aur un se kaha main ek zaroori aur ahem kaam ke liye apne makhsoos ahbab ke sath ja raha hoon. Agar ek saal ke andar andar aa jaoon to yeh mulk mera hai warna tumhein ikhtiyar hai jise chaho apna badshah tasleem kar lena. Unhon ne jawab diya ke hamare badshah to aap hi hain khwah das saal tak bhi aap na lautay to kya hua. Yeh yahan se mukhtasar si janbaz jamaat le kar chup chap chal khara hua. Posheeda raston se nihayat hoshiyari, ehtiyat aur chalaki se bohat jald Fars ke shehron tak pahunch gaya aur yak-a-yak dhawa bol diya, chunke yahan ki faujein to Room pahunch chuki thin, awam kahan tak muqabla karte. Usne qatl-e-aam shuru kiya. Jo samne aaya talwar ke kaam aaya, yunhi barhta chala gaya yahan tak ke Madain pahunch gaya jo Kisra ki saltanat ki kursi thi, wahan ki muhafiz fauj par bhi ghalib aaya, unhein bhi qatl kar diya aur charon taraf se maal jama kiya. Un ki tamam aurton ko qaid kar liya aur tamam larne walon ko qatl kar dala. Kisra ke larkay ko zinda giraftar kiya, us mehal-e-saraye ki aurton ko zinda giraftar kiya. Us ki darbardari aurtein waghera bhi pakri gayin, uske lashkar ka sar mundwa kar gadhay par bitha kar aurton samet Kisra ki taraf bheja ke lijiye jo maal aur aurtein aur ghulam tu ne mangay thay woh sab hazir hain. Jab yeh qafila Kisra ke paas pahuncha, Kisra ko sakht sadma hua. Yeh abhi tak Qustuntuniya ka muhasra kiye para tha aur Qaisar ki wapsi ka intezar kar raha tha ke us ke paas us ka kul khandan aur saari haram-sara is zillat ki halat mein pahunchi. Yeh sakht ghazabnak hua aur shehar par bohat sakht hamla kar diya lekin is mein koi kamyabi na hui. Ab yeh nehar-e-Jaihoon ki taraf chala ke Qaisar ko wahan rok le kyunke Qaisar ka Fars se Qustuntuniya aanay ka rasta yahi tha. Qaisar ne ise sun kar pehle se bhi zabardast hamla kiya, yani usne apne lashkar ko to darya ke is dahane chora aur khud thoray se aadmi le kar sawar ho kar pani ke bahao ki taraf chal diya. Koi ek din raat ka rasta chalne ke baad apne sath jo kayi chara, leed, gobar waghera le gaya tha use pani mein baha diya. Yeh cheezein pani mein behti hui Kisra ke lashkar ke paas se guzrin to woh samajh gaye ke Qaisar yahan se guzar gaya hai. Yeh us ke lashkaron ke janwaron ke aasar hain. Ab Qaisar wapas apne lashkar mein pahunch gaya, udhar Kisra us ki talash mein aagay chala gaya. Qaisar apne lashkaron samet Jaihoon ka dahana aboor kar ke rasta badal kar Qustuntuniya pahunch gaya. Jis din yeh apne dar-us-saltanat mein pahuncha, Nasraniyon mein bari khushiyan manayi gayin.

Kisra ko jab yeh ittila hui toh us ka ajab haal hua ke na paye mandan na jaye raftan, na toh Rum hi fath hua aur na Fars hi raha. Rumi ghalib aa gaye, Fars ki auratein aur wahan ke maal un ke qabze mein aaye. Yeh kul umoor nau saal mein hue aur Rumiyon ne apni khoi hui saltanat Farsiyon se dobara le li aur maghloob ho kar ghalib aa gaye. Azra'at aur Basra ke ma'arke mein Ahl-e-Fars ghalib aa gaye thay aur yeh mulk-e-Sham ka woh hissa tha jo Hijaz se milta tha, yeh bhi qaul hai ke yeh hazimat Jazeerah mein hui thi jo Rumiyon ki sarhad ka maqam hai aur Fars se milta hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir nau saal ke andar andar Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Quran-e-Kareem mein lafz 'biz' ka hai aur is ka itlaq bhi nau tak hota hai aur yahi tafseer is lafz ki Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Jarir wali hadith mein hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se farmaya tha ke tumhein ehtiyatan das saal tak rakhne chahiye thay kyunke 'biz' ke lafz ka itlaq teen se nau tak hota hai. Is ke baad qabl aur ba'd par pesh izafat hata dene ki wajah hai ke is ke baad hukm Allah hi ka hai. Us din jab ke Rum Fars par ghalib aa jaye ga toh Musalman khushiyan manayenge. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke Badr ki ladai wale din Rumi Farsiyon par ghalib aa gaye. Ibn-e-Abbas, Suddi, Thauri aur Abu Saeed yahi farmate hain. Ek giroh ka khayal hai ke yeh ghalba Hudaibiyah wale saal hua tha, Ikrimah, Zuhri aur Qatadah waghera ka yahi qaul hai. Baaz ne is ki taujeeh yeh bayan ki ke Qaisar-e-Rum ne nazr maani thi ke agar Allah Ta'ala use Fars par ghalib kare ga toh woh is ke shukr mein piyada Bait-ul-Muqaddas tak jaye ga, chunancha us ne apni nazr poori ki aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas pahuncha. Yeh yahin tha aur is ke paas Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka naama-e-mubarak pahuncha jo aap ne Hazrat Dihyah Kalbi (R.A) ki ma'rifat Basra ke governor ko bheja tha aur us ne Heraclius ko pahunchaya tha. Heraclius ne naama-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) paate hi Sham mein jo Hijazi Arab thay unhein apne paas bulaya, un mein Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb Umavi bhi tha aur dusre bhi Quraish ke zi-izzat bade bade log thay. Us ne un sab ko apne samne bitha kar un se poocha ke tum mein se is ka sab se zyada qareebi rishtedar kaun hai? Jis ne nabuwwat ka da'wa kiya hai. Abu Sufyan ne kaha main hoon. Badshah ne unhein aage bitha liya aur un ke sathiyon ko peeche bitha liya aur un se kaha ke dekho main is shakhs se chand sawalat karunga agar yeh kisi sawal ka ghalat jawab de toh tum is ko jhutla dena. Abu Sufyan ka qaul hai ke agar mujhe is baat ka dar na hota ke agar main jhoot bolunga toh log is ko zahir kar denge aur phir is jhoot ko meri taraf nisbat karenge toh yaqeenan main jhoot bolta. Ab Heraclius ne bahut se sawalat kiye. Maslan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hasb-o-nasab, aap ke ausaf-o-aadat ke mutaliq waghera waghera. Un mein ek sawal yeh bhi tha ke kya woh ghaddari karta hai? Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke aaj tak toh kabhi bad-ahdi, wa'da shikni aur ghaddari ki nahin. Is waqt hum mein is mein ek mu'ahida hai, na jaane is mein woh kya kare?

Abu Sufyan ke is qaul se murad Sulh-e-Hudaibiya hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Quraish ke darmiyan yeh baat thehri thi ke aapas mein das saal tak koi ladai na hogi. Yeh waqiya is qaul ki poori daleel ban sakta hai ke Roomi Fars par Hudaibiya wale saal ghalib aaye thay. Is liye ke Qaisar ne apni nazr Hudaibiya ke baad poori ki thi, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin is ka jawab woh log jo kehte hain ke ghalba-e-Room Fars par Badr wale saal hua tha yeh de sakte hain ke chunke mulk ki iqtisadi aur maali halat kharab ho chuki thi, veerani, ghair-abadi wa tang-hali bahut badh gayi thi, is liye chaar saal tak Heraclius ne apni poori tawajjah mulk ki khushhali aur abadi par rakhi. Is ke baad is taraf se itminan hasil karke nazr ko poori karne ke liye rawana hua, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh ikhtilaf koi aisa ahem amr nahin. Haan, Musalman Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hue is liye ke woh kaise hi hon taham thay Ahl-e-Kitab. Aur un ke muqable Majusiyon ki jamaat thi jinhein kitab se door ka talluq bhi na tha. Toh lazmi amr tha ke Musalman un ke ghalbe se na-khush hon aur Roomiyon ke ghalbe se khush hon. Khud Quran mein maujood hai ke imaan walon ke sab se zyada dushman Yahood aur Mushrik hain aur un se dostiyan rakhne mein sab se zyada qareeb woh log hain jo apne aap ko Nasara kehte hain is liye ke un mein ulama aur darwesh log hain aur yeh mutakabbir nahin, Quran sun kar yeh ro dete hain kyunke haq ko jaan lete hain phir iqrar karte hain ke Aye Allah hum imaan laye toh hamein bhi manne walon mein kar le. Pas yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke Musalman us din khush honge jis din Allah Ta'ala Roomiyon ki madad karega, woh jis ki chahta hai madad karta hai, woh bada ghalib aur bahut meharban hai. Hazrat Zubair Kalami farmate hain main ne Farsiyon ka Roomiyon par ghalib aana, phir Roomiyon ka Farsiyon par ghalib aana, phir Room aur Fars dono par Musalmanon ka ghalib aana apni aankhon se pandrah saal ke andar dekh liya. Aakhir-e-aayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne dushmanon se badla aur inteqam lene par qadir aur apne doston ki khataon aur laghzishon se darguzar farmane wala hai. Jo khabar tumhein di hai ke Roomi anqareeb Farsiyon par ghalib aa jayenge, yeh Allah ki khabar hai, Rabb ka wada hai, Parwardigar ka faisla hai. Namumkin hai ke ghalat nikle, tal jaye ya khilaf ho jaye. Jo haq ke qareeb ho use bhi Rabb haq se bahut door walon par ghalib rakhte hain, haan Allah ki hikmaton ko kam-ilm nahin jaan sakte. Aksar log duniya ka ilm toh khoob rakhte hain, is ki ghutiyan minton mein suljha dete hain, is mein khoob dimagh daudate hain. Is ke bure bhale nuqsan ko pehchan lete hain, ba-ek nigah is ki oonch neech dekh lete hain. Duniya kamane ka, paise jodne ka khoob saleeqa rakhte hain lekin umoor-e-deen mein, ukhrawi kamon mein mehez jahil, ghabi aur kam-fahm hote hain. Yahan na zehan kaam kare na samajh pahunch sake na ghaur-o-fikr ki aadat. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain bahut se aise bhi hain ke namaz tak toh theek padh nahin sakte lekin dirham chutki mein lete hi wazan bata diya karte hain.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki abadi aur raunaq ki toh beesiyon suratein unka zehan ghar leta hai. Lekin deen mein mehez jahil aur aakhirat se bilkul ghafil hain.

Kainat ka har zarra dawat-e-fikr deta hai, chunke kainat ka zarra zarra Haq Jalla Wa'ala ki qudrat ka nishan hai aur uski tauheed aur rububiyat par dalalat karne wala hai, is liye irshad hota hai ke maujudat mein gaur-o-fikr kiya karo aur Qudrat-e-Allah ki nishaniyon se us Malik ko pehchano aur uski qadr-o-ta'zeem karo. Kabhi aalam-e-ulvi ko dekho, kabhi aalam-e-sifli par nazar dalo, kabhi aur makhluqat ki paidaish ko socho aur samjho ke yeh cheezein abas aur bekar paida nahin ki gayin, balkeh Rabb ne inhe kar-amad aur nishan-e-qudrat banaya hai. Har ek ka ek waqt muqarrar hai, yani Qayamat ka din, jise aksar log maante hi nahin. Is ke baad Nabiyon ki sadaqat ko is tarah zahir farmata hai ke dekh lo un ke mukhalifeen ka kis qadr ibratnak anjam hua? Aur un ke manne walon ko kis tarah dono jahan ki izzat mili? Tum chal phir kar agle waqiyat maloom karo ke guzishta ummatein jo tum se zyada zor-awar thin, tum se zyada maal-o-zar wali thin, tum se zyada abadiyan unhone keen, tum se zyada khetiyan aur baghat un ke thay, is ke bawajud jab un ke paas us zamane ke Rasool aaye, unhone daleelein aur mojze dikhaye aur phir bhi us zamane ke un badnaseebon ne un ki na mani aur apne khayalat mein mustaghraq rahe aur siyah kariyon mein mashghul rahe, to bil-akhir azab-e-Allah un par baras pade. Us waqt koi na tha jo inhe bacha sake ya kisi azab ko un par se hata sake. Allah ki zaat is se paak hai ke woh apne bandon par zulm kare. Yeh azab to un ke apne kartooton ka wabal tha. Yeh Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlate thay, Rabb ki baton ka mazaq udate thay. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke un ki be-imani ki wajah se hum ne un ke dilon ko, un ki nigahon ko pher diya aur inhe un ki sarkashi mein hairan chhod diya hai. Aur aayat mein hai un ki kaji ki wajah se Allah ne un ke dil tedhe kar diye aur is aayat mein hai ke agar ab bhi munh modein to samajh le ke Allah Ta'ala un ke ba'az gunahon par un ki pakad karne ka irada kar chuka hai. Is bina par 'as-suwa' mansoob hoga 'asa'a' ka maf'ool ho kar. Aur yeh bhi qaul hai ke 'suwa' yahan par is tarah waqay hai ke burai un ka anjam hui. Is liye ke woh Aayat-e-Allah ke jhutlane wale aur un ka mazaq udane wale thay. To is ma'ani ki ro se yeh lafz mansoob hoga 'kana' ki khabar ho kar. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne yahi taujeeh bayan ki hai aur Ibn-e-Abbas aur Qatadah se naqal bhi ki hai. Zahhak bhi yahi farmate hain aur zahir bhi yahi hai kyunke is ke baad aayat (وَكَانُوْا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ 10ۧ) (Surah Ar-Rum: 10) hai.

A'maal ke mutabiq faislay. Farman-e-Bari Ta'ala hai ke sab se pehle makhlooqat ko isi Allah ne banaya aur jis tarah woh us ke paida karne par us waqt qadir tha, ab fana kar ke dobara paida karne par bhi woh utna hi balkeh us se bhi zyada qadir hai. Aur yeh un ke poori tarah mohtaj honge lekin woh un se bilkul aankhein pher lenge aur khud un ke maboodan-e-batila bhi un se kinara-kash ho jayenge aur saaf keh denge ke hum mein aur in mein koi dosti nahin. Woh sab se a'la bulandi par honge, yeh sab se zyada pasti mein honge. Phir is aayat ki tafseel hoti hai ke nek nafs to jannaton mein hansi khushi se honge aur kuffar Jahannam mein jal bhun rahe honge.

Khaliq-e-Kul Muqtadir-e-Kul hai. Us Rabb-e-Ta'ala ka kamal-e-qudrat aur azmat-e-saltanat par dalalat us ki tasbeeh aur us ki hamd se hai jis ki taraf Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki rahbari karta hai aur apna pak hona aur qabil-e-hamd hona bhi bayan farma raha hai. Sham ke waqt jabke raat apne andheron ko le aati hai aur subh ke waqt jabke din apni roshniyon ko le aata hai. Itna bayan farma kar us ke baad ka jumla bayan farmane se pehle hi yeh bhi zahir kar diya ke zameen-o-aasman mein qabil-e-hamd-o-sana wahi hai, un ki paidaish khud us ki buzurgi par daleel hai. Phir subh-o-sham ke waqton ki tasbeeh ka bayan jo pehle guzra tha us ke sath Isha aur Zuhr ka waqt mila liya, jo poore andhere aur kamil ujale ka waqt hota hai. Beshak tamam pakeezgi usi ko sazawar hai jo raat ke andheron ko aur din ke ujalon ko paida karne wala hai. Subh ka zahir karne wala, raat ko sukoon wali banane wala wahi hai. Is jaisi aayatein aur bhi bohat si hain. Aayat (وَالنَّهَارِ اِذَا جَلّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 3) aur (وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى) (Surah Al-Lail: 1) aur (وَالضُّحٰى وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا سَـجٰى) (Surah Ad-Duha: 1-2) waghera. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke main tumhein bataun ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ka naam Khalil (wafadar) kyun rakha? Is liye ke woh subh-o-sham in kalmaat ko parha karte thay. Phir aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (فَسُـبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ) se (وَلَهُ الْحَمْــدُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَعَشِـيًّا وَّحِيْنَ تُظْهِرُوْنَ) (Surah Ar-Rum: 17-18) tak ki dono aayatein tilawat farmayin. Tabrani ki hadith mein in dono aayaton ki nisbat hai ke jis ne subh-o-sham yeh parh lein us ne din raat mein jo cheez chhoot gayi use pa liya. Phir bayan farmaya ke maut-o-zeest ka khaliq, murdon se zindon ko aur zindon se murdon ko nikalne wala wahi hai. Har shay par aur us ki zidd par woh qadir hai, daane se darakht, darakht se daane, murghi se anda, ande se murghi, nutfay se insaan, insaan se nutfa, momin se kafir, kafir se momin, garz har cheez aur us ke muqabla ki cheez par use qudrat hasil hai. Khushk zameen ko wahi tar karta hai, banjar zameen se wahi zira'at paida karta hai jaise Surah Yaseen mein farmaya ke khushk zameen ka tar-o-taza ho kar tarah tarah ke anaaj-o-phal paida karna bhi meri qudrat ka ek kamil nishan hai. Ek aur aayat mein hai tumhare dekhte hue is zameen ko jis mein se dhuan uthta ho do boond se tar kar ke main lah-laha deta hoon aur har qisam ki paidawar se use sarsabz kar deta hoon. Aur bhi bohat si aayaton mein is mazmoon ko kahin mufassal kahin mujmal bayan farmaya. Yahan farmaya isi tarah tum sab bhi marne ke baad qabron mein se zinda kar ke kharay kar diye jaoge.

Batadreej nizam-e-hayat farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki beshumar nishaniyon mein se ek nishani yeh bhi hai ke usne tumhare baap Hazrat Adam A.S ko mitti se paida kiya. Tum sab ko usne be-waqat paani ke qatre se paida kiya. Phir tumhari bahut achi suratein banayin nutfe se khoon-e-basta ki shakal mein phir gosht ke lothre ki surat mein dhaal kar phir haddiyan banayin aur haddiyon ko gosht pehnaya. Phir rooh phonki, aankh, kaan, naak paida kiye, maa ke pet se salamti se nikala, phir kamzori ko quwwat se badla, din ba din taqatwar aur mazboot qad-awar zor-awar kiya, umr di, harkat-o-sukoon ki taqat di, asbaab aur aalaat diye aur makhlooq ka sardar banaya aur idhar se udhar pahunchne ke zaraye diye. Samundaron ki, zameen ki mukhtalif sawariyan ata farmayin, aql, soch, samajh, tadabbur, gaur ke liye dil-o-dimagh ata farmaye. Dunyawi kaam samjhaye, rizq, izzat hasil karne ke tariqe khol diye. Saath hi aakhirat ko sanwarne ka ilm aur dunyawi ilm bhi sikhaya. Paak hai woh Allah jo har cheez ka sahih andaza karta hai, har ek ko ek martabe par rakhta hai. Shakal-o-surat mein, bol chaal mein, amiri faqiri mein, aql-o-hunar mein, bhalai burai mein, sa'adat-o-shaqawat mein har ek ko judagana kar diya. Taake har shakhs Rabb ki bahut si nishaniyan apne mein aur dusre mein dekh le. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tamam zameen se ek mutthi mitti ki lekar us se Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kiya. Pas zameen ke mukhtalif hisson ki tarah aulad-e-Adam ki mukhtalif rangatein huin. Koi safed, koi surkh, koi siyah, koi khabees, koi tayyab, koi khush-khulq, koi bad-khulq waghera. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki ek nishani-e-qudrat yeh bhi hai ke usne tumhari hi jins se tumhare jode banaye ke woh tumhari biwiyan banti hain aur tum unke khawand hote ho. Yeh is liye ke tumhein un se sukoon-o-rahat, aaram-o-asaish hasil ho. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein ek hi nafs se paida kiya aur usi se uski biwiyan paida ki taake woh uski taraf rahat hasil kare. Hazrat Hawa Hazrat Adam ki bayin pasli se jo sab se zyada choti hai paida hui hain, pas agar insaan ka joda insaan se na milta aur kisi aur jins se unka joda bandhta to maujooda ulfat-o-rahmat in mein na ho sakti. Yeh pyar, ikhlas, yak-jinsi ki wajah se hai. In mein aapas mein mohabbat, mawaddat, rahmat, ulfat, pyar, ikhlas, raham aur meherbani daal di, pas mard ya to mohabbat ki wajah se aurat ki khabar-giri karta hai ya gham khakar uska khayal rakhta hai. Is liye ke us se aulad ho chuki hai, uski parwarish in dono ke mel-milap par mauqoof hai. Al-garaz bahut si wajoohaat Rabb-ul-Alameen ne rakh di hain, jin ke ba'is insaan ba-aaram apne jode ke saath zindagi guzarta hai. Yeh bhi Rabb ki meherbani aur uski qudrat-e-kamilah ki ek zabardast nishani hai. Adna gaur se insaan ka zehan is tak pahunch jata hai.
