Tum sab ko usne be-waqat paani ke qatre se paida kiya. Phir tumhari bahut achi suratein banayin nutfe se khoon-e-basta ki shakal mein phir gosht ke lothre ki surat mein dhaal kar phir haddiyan banayin aur haddiyon ko gosht pehnaya. Phir rooh phonki, aankh, kaan, naak paida kiye, maa ke pet se salamti se nikala, phir kamzori ko quwwat se badla, din ba din taqatwar aur mazboot qad-awar zor-awar kiya, umr di, harkat-o-sukoon ki taqat di, asbaab aur aalaat diye aur makhlooq ka sardar banaya aur idhar se udhar pahunchne ke zaraye diye. Samundaron ki, zameen ki mukhtalif sawariyan ata farmayin, aql, soch, samajh, tadabbur, gaur ke liye dil-o-dimagh ata farmaye. Dunyawi kaam samjhaye, rizq, izzat hasil karne ke tariqe khol diye. Saath hi aakhirat ko sanwarne ka ilm aur dunyawi ilm bhi sikhaya. Paak hai woh Allah jo har cheez ka sahih andaza karta hai, har ek ko ek martabe par rakhta hai. Shakal-o-surat mein, bol chaal mein, amiri faqiri mein, aql-o-hunar mein, bhalai burai mein, sa'adat-o-shaqawat mein har ek ko judagana kar diya. Taake har shakhs Rabb ki bahut si nishaniyan apne mein aur dusre mein dekh le. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tamam zameen se ek mutthi mitti ki lekar us se Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kiya. Pas zameen ke mukhtalif hisson ki tarah aulad-e-Adam ki mukhtalif rangatein huin. Koi safed, koi surkh, koi siyah, koi khabees, koi tayyab, koi khush-khulq, koi bad-khulq waghera. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki ek nishani-e-qudrat yeh bhi hai ke usne tumhari hi jins se tumhare jode banaye ke woh tumhari biwiyan banti hain aur tum unke khawand hote ho. Yeh is liye ke tumhein un se sukoon-o-rahat, aaram-o-asaish hasil ho. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein ek hi nafs se paida kiya aur usi se uski biwiyan paida ki taake woh uski taraf rahat hasil kare. Hazrat Hawa Hazrat Adam ki bayin pasli se jo sab se zyada choti hai paida hui hain, pas agar insaan ka joda insaan se na milta aur kisi aur jins se unka joda bandhta to maujooda ulfat-o-rahmat in mein na ho sakti. Yeh pyar, ikhlas, yak-jinsi ki wajah se hai. In mein aapas mein mohabbat, mawaddat, rahmat, ulfat, pyar, ikhlas, raham aur meherbani daal di, pas mard ya to mohabbat ki wajah se aurat ki khabar-giri karta hai ya gham khakar uska khayal rakhta hai. Is liye ke us se aulad ho chuki hai, uski parwarish in dono ke mel-milap par mauqoof hai. Al-garaz bahut si wajoohaat Rabb-ul-Alameen ne rakh di hain, jin ke ba'is insaan ba-aaram apne jode ke saath zindagi guzarta hai. Yeh bhi Rabb ki meherbani aur uski qudrat-e-kamilah ki ek zabardast nishani hai. Adna gaur se insaan ka zehan is tak pahunch jata hai.

Yeh rang, yeh zabanain aur wasee-tar kainat Rabb-ul-Alameen apni zabardast qudrat ki ek nishani aur bayan farmata hai ke is qadar buland kushada aasman ki paidaish, is mein sitaron ka jadao, un ki chamak damak, un mein se baaz ka chalta phirta hona, baaz ka ek ja sabit rehna, zameen ko ek thos shakal mein banana, usay kaseef paida karna, is mein pahar, maidan, jangal, darya, samundar, teelay, patthar, darakht waghera jama dena. Khud tumhari zabanon mein, rangaton mein ikhtilaf rakhna, Arab ki zaban, Tatariyon ki zaban, Kurdon, Roomiyon, Farangiyon, Takroniyon, Barbar, Habshiyon, Hindiyon, Iraniyon, Haqabla, Armaniyon, Jazriyon aur Allah janay kitni kitni zabanain zameen par Bani Adam mein boli jati hain. Insani zabanon ke ikhtilaf ke sath hi un ki rangaton ka ikhtilaf bhi shan-e-Allah ka mazhar hai. Khayal toh farmaiye ke lakhon aadmi jama ho jayain, ek kunbay, qabeelay ke, ek mulk, ek zaban ke hon lekin namumkin hai ke har ek mein koi na koi ikhtilaf na ho. Halankeh aaza-e-badan ke aitbar se kulli muwafiqat hai. Sab ki do aankhain, do palkain, ek naak, do do kaan, ek peshani, ek munh, do hont, do rukhsaar waghera lekin taham ek se ek alaihda hai. Koi na koi aadat, khaslat, kalam, baat cheet, tarz-e-ada aisi zaroor hogi ke jis mein ek dusray ka imtiyaz ho jaye, go woh baaz martaba posheeda si aur halki si cheezain hi hon. Go khubsurti aur badsurti mein kayi ek yaksan nazar ayain lekin jab gaur kiya jaye toh har ek ko dusray se mumtaz karne wala koi na koi wasf zaroor nazar aa jaye ga. Har janne wala itni bari taqaton aur quwwaton ke malik ko pehchan sakta hai aur is sanat se Sani ko jaan sakta hai. Neend bhi qudrat ki ek nishani hai jis se thakan door ho jati hai, rahat-o-sukoon hasil hota hai, is ke liye qudrat ne raat bana di. Kaam kaaj ke liye, duniya hasil karne ke liye, kamai dhanday ke liye, talash-e-ma'ash ke liye Allah ne din ko paida kar diya jo raat ke bilkul khilaf hai. Yaqeenan sunne samajhne walon ke liye yeh cheezain nishan-e-qudrat hain. Tabrani mein Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) se marwi hai ke raton ko meri neend uchat ho jaya karti thi toh main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is amr ki shikayat ki, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh dua parha karo: (Allahumma gharat-in-nujoom wa hadat-il-uyoon wa anta Hayyun Qayyoom, ya Hayyu ya Qayyoom, anim ayni wa ahdi layli). Main ne jab is dua ko parha toh neend na aane ki bimari ba-fazl-e-Allah door ho gayi.

Qayam-e-Arz-o-Sama Allah Ta'ala ki azmat par dalalat karne wali ek aur nishani bayan ki ja rahi hai ke aasmanon par uske hukm se bijli kondti hai jise dekh kar kabhi tumhein dehshat lagne lagti hai ke kahin aisa na ho ke kadak kisi ko halak karde, kahin bijli gire waghera aur kabhi tumhein umeed bandhti hai ke achha hua ab barish barsegi, pani ki rail-pel hogi, tarsali ho jayegi waghera. Wohi hai jo aasman se pani utarta hai aur is zameen ko jo khushk padi hui thi, jis par naam-o-nishan ki koi haryawal na thi, misl murde ke bekar thi, is barish se woh zinda kar dene par qadir hai. Uski ek nishani yeh bhi hai ke zameen-o-aasman usi ke hukm se qaim hain, woh aasman ko zameen par girne nahin deta aur aasman ko thame hue hai aur unhein zawal se bachaye hue hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) jab koi takeedi qasam khana chahte to farmate: "Us Allah ki qasam jiske hukm se zameen-o-aasman thehre hue hain." Phir Qayamat ke din woh zameen-o-aasman ko badal dega, murde apni qabron se zinda karke nikale jayenge. Khud Allah unhein aawaz dega aur yeh sirf ek aawaz par zinda ho kar apni qabron se nikal khade honge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jis din woh tumhein pukarega tum uski hamd karte hue use jawab doge aur yaqeen kar loge ke tum bahut hi kam rahe. Aur aayat mein hai (Fa-innama hiya zajratun wahidah) (Surah An-Nazi'at: 13) sirf ek hi aawaz se sari makhlooq maidan-e-hashr mein jama ho jayegi aur aayat mein hai (In kanat illa saihatan wahidatan fa-iza hum jami'ul ladaina muhdarun) (Surah Yaseen: 53) yani woh to sirf ek aawaz hogi jise sunte hi sab ke sab hamare samne hazir ho jayenge.

Jis ka koi hamsar nahin farmata hai ke tamam aasmanon aur sari zameenon ki makhlooq Allah hi ki hai sab us ke laundi ghulam hain sab usi ki malkiyat hain. Har ek us ke samne aajiz-o-lachar majboor-o-be-bas hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke Quran-e-Kareem mein jahan kahin Qunoot ka zikr hai wahan murad ita'at-o-farmanbardari hai. Ibtidai paidaish bhi usi ne ki aur wahi i'ada bhi karega aur i'ada ba-nisbat ibtida ke adatan aasan aur halka hota hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke mujhe Ibn-e-Adam jhutlata hai aur use yeh chahiye nahin tha. Woh mujhe bura kehta hai aur yeh bhi use laiq na tha. Us ka jhutlana toh yeh hai ke kehta hai jis tarah us ne mujhe awwalan paida kiya us tarah dobara paida kar nahin sakta halankeh dusri martaba ki paidaish pehli dafa ki paidaish se bilkul aasan hua karti hai us ka mujhe bura kehna yeh hai ke kehta hai ke Allah ki aulad hai halankeh main Ahad aur Samad hoon. Jis ki na aulad na maa baap aur jis ka koi hamsar nahin. Al-gharaz dono paidaishein us Malik ki qudrat ki mazhar hain na us par koi kaam bhari na bojhal. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke 'hu' ki zameer ka marja khalq ho. Misl se murad yahan us ki Tauheed-e-Uluhiyat aur Tauheed-e-Rububiyat hai na ke misaal is liye ke Allah Ta'ala ki zaat misaal se paak hai farman hai aayat (Laisa kamithlihi shai) us ki misaal koi aur nahin. Ba'az ahl-e-zauq ne kaha hai ke jab saaf shaffaf paani ka suthra paak saaf hauz thehra hua ho aur baad-e-saba ke thapeere use hilate julate na hon us waqt us mein aasman saaf nazar aata hai suraj aur chand sitare bilkul dikhai dete hain isi tarah buzurgon ke dil hain jin mein woh Allah ki azmat-o-jalal ko hamesha dekhte rehte hain. Woh Ghalib hai jis par kisi ka bas nahin na us ke samne kisi ki kuch chal sake har cheez us ki matahuti mein aur us ke samne past-o-lachar aajiz-o-be-bas hai. Us ki qudrat satwat saltanat har cheez par muheet hai. Woh Hakeem hai apne aqwal, af'aal, shariat, taqdeer, gharz har har amr mein. Hazrat Muhammad bin Munkadir farmate hain Misl-e-A'ala se murad La Ilaha Illallah hai.

Apne dilon mein jhanko! Mushrikeen-e-Makkah apne buzurgon ko shareek-e-Allah jaante thay lekin saath hi yeh bhi maante thay ke yeh sab Allah ke ghulam aur uske matahat hain. Chunancha woh Hajj-o-Umre ke mauqe par labbaik pukarte hue kehte thay ke (Labbaik La Shareeka Laka Illa Shareekan Huwa Laka Tamlikuhu Wa Ma Malak) yani hum tere darbar mein hazir hain tera koi shareek nahin magar woh ke woh khud aur jis cheez ka woh maalik hai sab teri malkiyat mein hain. Yani hamare shareekon ka aur unki malkiyat ka tu hi asli maalik hai. Pas yahan unhein ek aisi misaal se samjhaya ja raha hai jo khud yeh apne nafs hi mein payein aur bahut achi tarah gaur-o-khauz kar sakein. Farmata hai ke kya tum mein se koi bhi is amr par razamand hoga ke uske kul maal waghera mein uske ghulam uske barabar ke shareek hon aur har waqt use yeh dhadka rehta ho ke kahin woh taqseem karke meri jaidad aur malkiyat aadhon aadh baant na le jayein. Pas jis tarah tum yeh baat apne liye pasand nahin karte Allah ke liye bhi na chaho, jis tarah ghulam aaqa ki hamsari nahin kar sakta isi tarah Allah ka koi banda Allah ka shareek nahin ho sakta. Yeh ajab na-insafi hai ke apne liye jis baat se chidhein aur nafrat karein Allah ke liye wahi baat saabit karne baith jayein. Khud betiyon se jalte thay, itna sunte hi ke tere yahan ladki hui hai munh kaale pad jaate thay aur Allah ke muqarrab farishton ko Allah ki ladkiyan kehte thay. Isi tarah khud is baat ke kabhi rawa-daar nahin hote ke apne ghulamon ko apna barabar ka shareek-o-saheem samjhein lekin Allah ke ghulamon ko Allah ka shareek samajh rahe hain, kis qadar insaaf ka khooni hai? Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke mushrik jo labbaik pukarte thay aur us par yeh aayat utri. Aur is mein bayaan hai ke jab tum apne ghulamon ko apne barabar ka shareek thehrane se aar rakhte ho to Allah ke ghulamon ko Allah ka shareek kyun thehra rahe ho. Yeh saaf baat bayaan farma kar irshad farmata hai ke hum isi tarah tafseel-war dalail ghafilon ke saamne rakh dete hain, phir farmata hai aur batlata hai ke mushrikeen ke shirk ki koi sanad-e-aqli naqli koi daleel nahin, sirf karishma-e-jahalat aur pairwi-e-khwahish hai. Jabke yeh raah-e-raast se hat gaye to phir unhein Allah ke siwa aur koi raah-e-raast par la nahin sakta. Yeh go dusron ko apna kaarsaaz aur madadgar maante hain lekin waqiya yeh hai ke dushmanan-e-Allah ka dost koi nahin. Kaun hai jo uski marzi ke khilaf lab hila sake? Kaun hai jo us par meherbani kare jis par Allah na-meharban ho? Jo woh chahe wahi hota hai aur jise woh na chahe ho nahin sakta.

Bachcha aur maa baap millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif par jam jao jis deen ko Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye muqarrar kardiya hai aur jise ae Nabi aap ke haath par Allah ne kamaal ko pahunchaya hai, Rabb ki fitrat-e-saleema par wahi qaim hai jo is deen-e-Islam ka paband hai. Isi par yani tauheed par Rabb ne tamam insano ko banaya hai. Roz-e-awwal mein isi ka sab se iqrar karaliya gaya tha ke kya main sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Toh sab ne iqrar kiya ke beshak tu hi hamara Rabb hai. Woh hadeesein anqareeb Insha'Allah bayan hongi jin se saabit hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apni jumla makhlooq ko apne sachay deen par paida kiya hai go is ke baad log yahoodiyat, nasraniyat waghera par chalay gaye. Logo Allah ki is fitrat ko na badlo. Logo ko is raah-e-raast se na hatao. Toh yeh khabar ma'ani mein amr hogi jaise aayat (Wa man dakhalahu kaana aamina) (3. Aal-e-Imran: 97) mein yeh ma'ani nihayat umdah aur sahih hain. Dusre ma'ani yeh bhi hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne tamam makhlooq ko fitrat-e-saleema par yani deen-e-Islam par paida kiya. Rabb ke is deen mein koi tabaddul-o-taghayyur nahin. Imam Bukhari ne yahi ma'ani kiye hain ke yahan khalq-e-Allah se muraad deen aur fitrat-e-Islam hai. Bukhari Shareef mein barwayat-e-Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmaan-e-Rasool hai ke har bachcha fitrat par paida hota hai phir us ke maa baap use yahoodi, nasrani aur majoosi banadete hain. Jaise bakri ka sahih saalim bachcha hota hai jis ke kaan log katar dete hain. Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat ki (Fitratallahi-llati fataran-naasa alaiha, la tabdeela likhalqillah, zaalika deenul-qayyimu wa laakinna aksaran-naasi la ya'lamoon) (30. Ar-Room: 30). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Aswad bin Saree R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aap ke saath mil kar kuffaar se jihad kiya, wahan hum bafazl-e-Allah ghaalib aagaye, us din logo ne bahut se kuffaar ko qatl kiya yahan tak ke chhotay bachchon ko bhi qatl kardala. Huzoor ﷺ ko pata chala toh aap bahut naraaz hue aur farmane lage yeh kya baat hai log had se aagay nikal jaate hain aaj bachchon ko bhi qatl kardiya hai. Kisi ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aakhir woh bhi toh mushrikeen ki hi aulaad thi, aap ne farmaya nahin nahin. Yaad rakho tum mein se behtareen log mushrikeen ke bachay hain. Khabardaar bachchon ko kabhi qatl na karna, na-baalighon ke qatl se ruk jaana. Har bachcha fitrat par paida hota hai yahan tak ke apni zabaan se kuch kahe phir us ke maa baap use yahood, nasrani banalete hain. Jabir bin Abdullah ki riwayat se Musnad Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain har bachcha fitrat par paida hota hai yahan tak ke use zabaan aajaye. Ab ya toh shaakir banta hai ya kaafir. Musnad mein barwayat-e-Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se mushrikon ki aulaad ke baare mein sawaal kiya gaya toh aap ne farmaya ke jab unhein Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya woh khoob jaanta tha ke woh kya aamaal karne waale hain.

Aap se marvi hai ke ek zamana mein main kehta tha musalmanon ki aulad musalmanon ke sath hai aur mushrikon ki aulad mushrikon ke sath hai yahan tak ke falan shakhs ne falan se riwayat karke mujhe sunaya ke jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mushrikon ke bachon ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to aap ne farmaya Allah khoob aalim hai us cheez se jo woh karte. Is hadith ko sun kar main ne apna fatwa chhor diya. Hazrat Iyad bin Himar (R.A) se Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek khutba mein farmaya ke mujhe Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ne hukum diya ke jo us ne mujhe aaj sikhaya hai aur us se tum jahil ho woh main tumhein sikha doon. Farmaya ke jo main ne apne bandon ko diya hai main ne un ke liye halal kiya hai main ne apne sab bandon ko yak-tarfa khalis deen wala banaya hai un ke paas shaitan pahunchta hai aur unhein deen se gumrah karta hai aur halal ko un par haram karta hai aur unhein mere sath shareek karne ko kehta hai jis ki koi daleel nahin. Allah Ta'ala ne zameen walon ki taraf nigah dali aur Arab-o-Ajam sab ko napasand farmaya siwaye chand Ahl-e-Kitab ke kuch logon ke. Woh farmata hai ke main ne tujhe sirf aazmaish ke liye bheja hai teri apni bhi aazmaish hogi aur teri wajah se aur sab ki bhi. Main to tujh par woh kitab utarunga jise pani dho na sake tu use sote jagte parhta rahega. Phir mujh se Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ne irshad farmaya ke main Quraish ko hoshiyar kar doon main ne apna andesha zahir kiya ke kahin woh mera sar kuchal kar roti jaisa na bana dein? To farmaya sun jaise yeh tujhe nikalein ge main unhein nikalunga tu un se jihad kar main tera sath dunga tu kharch kar tujh par kharch kiya jaye ga. Tu lashkar bhej main us se paanch hisse zyada lashkar bhejunga farmabardaron ke liye apne nafarmaron. Ahl-e-Jannat teen qisam ke hain: Aadil badshah, taufiq-e-khair wala sakhi. Narm dil har musalman ke sath sulook-e-ehsan karne wala. Pak daman sawal aur haram se bachne wala ayal-dar aadmi. Ahl-e-Jahannam paanch qisam ke log hain: Woh be-waqat kamine log jo be-zar aur be-ghar hain jo tumhare damanon mein lipte rehte hain. Woh khain jo haqeer cheezon mein bhi khayanat kiye baghair nahin rehta. Woh log jo har waqt logon ko un ki jaan maal aur ahl-o-ayal mein dhoke mein rakhte hain subh-o-sham chalbaziyon aur makr-o-fareb mein lage rehte hain. Phir aap ne bakhili ya kazzab ka zikr kiya aur farmaya paanchon qisam ke log bad-zaban bad-go hain (Muslim waghera). Yehi fitrat-e-saleema yehi shariat ko mazbooti se thame rehna hi sache aur seedha deen hai. Lekin aksar log be-ilm hain. Aur apni isi jahalat ki wajah se Allah ke aise pak deen se door balkeh mehroom reh jate hain. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai go teri hirs ho lekin un mein se aksar log be-imaan hi rahenge. Ek aur aayat mein hai agar tu aksariyat ki itaat kare ga to woh tujhe rah-e-Allah se behka dein ge. Tum sab Allah ki taraf raghib raho isi ki janib jhuke raho isi ka dar khauf rakho aur isi ka lihaz rakho. Namazon ki pabandi karo jo sab se bari ibadat aur itaat hai.

Tum mushrik na bano balkay muwahhid aur khalis ban jao, us ke siwa kisi aur se koi murad wabasta na rakho. Hazrat Mu'az se Hazrat Umar ne is ayat ka matlab poocha to aap ne farmaya yeh teen cheezein hain aur yahi nijat ki jarein hain. Awwal ikhlas jo fitrat hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko paida kiya hai, dusre namaz jo darasal deen hai, teesre ita'at jo ismat aur bachao hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya aap ne sach kaha. Tumhein mushrikon mein na milna chahiye, tumhein un ka sath na dena chahiye aur na un jaise fe'l karna chahiye jinhon ne deen-e-Allah ko badal diya, ba'az baton ko maan liya aur ba'az se inkar kar gaye. Farraqu ki dusri qira'at Faraqu hai yani unhon ne apne deen ko chhor diya. Jaise Yahood, Nasara, Majoosi, but parast se aur dusre batil mazahib wale. Jaise irshad hai jin logon ne apne deen mein tafreeq ki aur giroh bandi kar li to un mein shamil hi nahin, un ka anjam supurd-e-Allah hai. Tum se pehle wali qomein giroh giroh ho gayi thin. Is ummat mein bhi tafriqa para lekin un mein ek haq par hai, haan baqi sab gumrahi par hain. Yeh haq wali jama'at Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at hai jo Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah ko mazboot thamne wali hai. Jis par sabqa zamane ke Sahaba, Tabi'een aur A'imma-e-Muslimeen thay, guzishta zamane mein bhi aur ab bhi. Jaise Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya gaya ke in sab mein nijat pane wala firqa kaun sa hai? To aap ne farmaya (Man kana 'ala ma ana 'alaihi wa ashabi) yani woh log jo us par hon jis par aaj main aur mere as-hab hain. (Baradaran ghaur farmaiye ke woh cheez jis par Rasoolullah ﷺ aur aap ke as-hab R.A aap ke zamane mein thay woh Wahi-e-Allah yani Quran-o-Hadith hi thi ya kisi Imam ki taqleed?)

To farmaya sun jaise yeh tujhe nikalein ge main unhein nikalunga tu un se jihad kar main tera sath dunga tu kharch kar tujh par kharch kiya jaye ga. Tu lashkar bhej main us se paanch hisse zyada lashkar bhejunga farmabardaron ke liye apne nafarmaron. Ahl-e-Jannat teen qisam ke hain: Aadil badshah, taufiq-e-khair wala sakhi. Narm dil har musalman ke sath sulook-e-ehsan karne wala. Pak daman sawal aur haram se bachne wala ayal-dar aadmi. Ahl-e-Jahannam paanch qisam ke log hain: Woh be-waqat kamine log jo be-zar aur be-ghar hain jo tumhare damanon mein lipte rehte hain. Woh khain jo haqeer cheezon mein bhi khayanat kiye baghair nahin rehta. Woh log jo har waqt logon ko un ki jaan maal aur ahl-o-ayal mein dhoke mein rakhte hain subh-o-sham chalbaziyon aur makr-o-fareb mein lage rehte hain. Phir aap ne bakhili ya kazzab ka zikr kiya aur farmaya paanchon qisam ke log bad-zaban bad-go hain (Muslim waghera). Yehi fitrat-e-saleema yehi shariat ko mazbooti se thame rehna hi sache aur seedha deen hai. Lekin aksar log be-ilm hain. Aur apni isi jahalat ki wajah se Allah ke aise pak deen se door balkeh mehroom reh jate hain. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai go teri hirs ho lekin un mein se aksar log be-imaan hi rahenge. Ek aur aayat mein hai agar tu aksariyat ki itaat kare ga to woh tujhe rah-e-Allah se behka dein ge. Tum sab Allah ki taraf raghib raho isi ki janib jhuke raho isi ka dar khauf rakho aur isi ka lihaz rakho. Namazon ki pabandi karo jo sab se bari ibadat aur itaat hai.

Tum mushrik na bano balkay muwahhid aur khalis ban jao, us ke siwa kisi aur se koi murad wabasta na rakho. Hazrat Mu'az se Hazrat Umar ne is ayat ka matlab poocha to aap ne farmaya yeh teen cheezein hain aur yahi nijat ki jarein hain. Awwal ikhlas jo fitrat hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko paida kiya hai, dusre namaz jo darasal deen hai, teesre ita'at jo ismat aur bachao hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya aap ne sach kaha. Tumhein mushrikon mein na milna chahiye, tumhein un ka sath na dena chahiye aur na un jaise fe'l karna chahiye jinhon ne deen-e-Allah ko badal diya, ba'az baton ko maan liya aur ba'az se inkar kar gaye. Farraqu ki dusri qira'at Faraqu hai yani unhon ne apne deen ko chhor diya. Jaise Yahood, Nasara, Majoosi, but parast se aur dusre batil mazahib wale. Jaise irshad hai jin logon ne apne deen mein tafreeq ki aur giroh bandi kar li to un mein shamil hi nahin, un ka anjam supurd-e-Allah hai. Tum se pehle wali qomein giroh giroh ho gayi thin. Is ummat mein bhi tafriqa para lekin un mein ek haq par hai, haan baqi sab gumrahi par hain. Yeh haq wali jama'at Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at hai jo Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah ko mazboot thamne wali hai. Jis par sabqa zamane ke Sahaba, Tabi'een aur A'imma-e-Muslimeen thay, guzishta zamane mein bhi aur ab bhi. Jaise Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya gaya ke in sab mein nijat pane wala firqa kaun sa hai? To aap ne farmaya (Man kana 'ala ma ana 'alaihi wa ashabi) yani woh log jo us par hon jis par aaj main aur mere as-hab hain. (Baradaran ghaur farmaiye ke woh cheez jis par Rasoolullah ﷺ aur aap ke as-hab R.A aap ke zamane mein thay woh Wahi-e-Allah yani Quran-o-Hadith hi thi ya kisi Imam ki taqleed?)

Insaan ki mukhtalif halatein: Allah Ta'ala logon ki halat bayan farma rahe hain ke dukh, dard, museebat-o-takleef ke waqt toh woh Allah Wahdahu La-Shareeka Lahu ko badi aajizi, zaari, nihayat tawajjah aur poori dilsozi ke sath pukarte hain aur jab uski ne'matein un par barasne lagti hain toh yeh Allah ke sath shirk karne lagte hain. Likfuru mein 'Laam' ba'az toh kehte hain 'Laam-e-Aaqibat' hai aur ba'az kehte hain 'Laam-e-Ta'leel' hai. Lekin 'Laam-e-Ta'leel' hona is wajah se bhala maloom hota hai ke Allah ne un ke liye yeh muqarrar kiya phir unhein dhamkaya ke tum abhi maloom kar loge. Ba'az buzurgon ka farman hai ke kotwal ya sipahi agar kisi ko daraye dhamkaye toh woh kanp uthta hai, ta'ajjub hai ke us ke dhamkane se hum dehshat mein ayen jis ke qabze mein har cheez hai aur jis ka sirf yeh keh dena har amr ke liye kaafi hai ke "ho ja". Phir mushrikeen ka mahaz be-daleel hona bayan farmaya ja raha hai ke hum ne un ke shirk ki koi daleel nahin utari. Phir insaan ki ek behooda khaslat bator-e-inkaar bayan ho rahi hai ke siwaye chand hastiyon ke umooman halat yeh hai ke rahaton ke waqt phool jaate hain aur sakhtiyon ke waqt mayoos ho jaate hain. Goya ab koi behtari milegi nahin. Haan, momin sakhtiyon mein sabr aur narmiyon mein nekiyan karte hain. Sahih hadith mein hai: Momin par ta'ajjub hai, us ke liye Allah ki har qaza behtar hi hoti hai. Rahat par shukr karta hai toh yeh bhi us ke liye behtar hota hai aur museebat par sabr karta hai toh yeh bhi us ke liye behtar hota hai. Allah Ta'ala hi mutasarrif aur maalik hai. Woh apni hikmat ke mutabiq jahan ka nizam chala raha hai, kisi ko kam deta hai kisi ko zyada deta hai. Koi tangi-o-turshi mein hai, koi wus'at aur farakhi mein. Is mein mominon ke liye nishaniyan hain.

Silah-e-rehmi ki takeed. Qarabat-daron ke sath neki, sulook aur silah-e-rehmi karne ka hukum ho raha hai. Miskeen use kehte hain jis ke paas kuch na ho ya kuch ho lekin ba-qadr-e-kifayat na ho. Is ke sath bhi sulook-o-ehsan karne ka hukum ho raha hai. Musafir jis ka kharch kam par gaya ho aur safar kharch paas na raha ho, us ke sath bhi bhalai karne ka irshad hota hai. Yeh un ke liye behtar hai jo chahte hain ke Qayamat ke din deedar-e-Allah karein, haqeeqat mein insan ke liye is se bari nemat koi nahin. Duniya aur Aakhirat mein nijat aise hi logon ko milegi. Is dusri aayat ki tafseer to Ibn-e-Abbas, Mujahid, Zahhak, Qatadah, Ikrimah, Muhammad bin Ka'ab aur Sha'bi se yeh marwi hai ke jo shakhs koi atiya is iraday se de ke log use is se zyada dein, to go is iraday se hadiya dena to mubah hai lekin sawab se khali hai. Allah ke haan is ka badla kuch nahin. Magar Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is se bhi rok diya, is ma'ani mein yeh hukum aap ke liye makhsoos hoga. Isi ki mushabah aayat (وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ) (74. Al-Muddaththir: 6) hai, yani zyadati-e-muawiza ki niyat se kisi ke sath ehsan na kiya karo. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke sood yani nafa ki do suratein hain, ek to byopar-o-tijarat mein sood, yeh to haram-e-mehez hai. Dusra sood yani zyadati jis mein koi haraj nahin, woh kisi ko is iraday se hadiya-o-tohfa dena hai ke yeh mujhe is se zyada de. Phir aap ne yeh aayat parh kar farmaya ke Allah ke paas sawab to Zakat ke ada karne ka hai. Zakat dene walon ko bohat barkatein hoti hain. Sahih hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs ek khajoor bhi sadqay mein de lekin halal tor se hasil ki hui ho, to use Allah Ta'ala Rahman-o-Raheem apne dayein hath mein leta hai aur is tarah palta aur barhata hai jis tarah tum mein se koi apne ghore ya oont ke bachay ki parwarish karta hai, yahan tak ke wahi ek khajoor Uhud pahar se bhi bari ho jati hai. Allah hi Khaliq-o-Raziq hai. Insan apni maa ke pait se nanga, be-ilm, be-kaan, be-aankh, be-taqat nikalta hai, phir Allah Ta'ala use sab cheezein ata farmata hai. Maal, malkiyat, kamai, tijarat, garz beshumar neamatein ata farmata hai. Do sahabiyon ka bayan hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue, us waqt aap kisi kaam mein mashghool thay, hum ne bhi aap ka hath bataya. Aap ne farmaya ke dekho, sar hilne lage tab tak bhi rozi se koi mehroom nahin rehta. Insan nanga bhooka duniya mein aata hai, ek chhilka bhi us ke badan par nahin hota, phir Rabb hi use roziyan deta hai. Is hayat ke baad tumhein maar dalega, phir Qayamat ke din zinda karega. Allah ke siwa tum jin jin ki ibadat kar rahe ho, un mein se ek bhi in baton mein se kisi ek par qaboo nahin rakhta. In kamon mein se ek bhi koi nahin kar sakta. Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala hi tanha Khaliq, Raziq aur maut-o-zindagi ka malik hai, wahi Qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq ko jila dega.

Is ki muqaddas munazzah mu'azzam aur izzat-o-jalal wali zaat is se paak hai ke koi is ka shareek ho ya is jaisa ho ya is ke barabar ho ya is ki aulad ho ya maa baap hon. Woh Ahad hai, Samad hai, Fard hai, maa baap aulad se paak hai, is ka kuf koi nahin.

Is dusri aayat ki tafseer to Ibn-e-Abbas, Mujahid, Zahhak, Qatadah, Ikrimah, Muhammad bin Ka'ab aur Sha'bi se yeh marwi hai ke jo shakhs koi atiya is iraday se de ke log use is se zyada dein, to go is iraday se hadiya dena to mubah hai lekin sawab se khali hai. Allah ke haan is ka badla kuch nahin. Magar Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is se bhi rok diya, is ma'ani mein yeh hukum aap ke liye makhsoos hoga. Isi ki mushabah aayat (وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ) (74. Al-Muddaththir: 6) hai, yani zyadati-e-muawiza ki niyat se kisi ke sath ehsan na kiya karo. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke sood yani nafa ki do suratein hain, ek to byopar-o-tijarat mein sood, yeh to haram-e-mehez hai. Dusra sood yani zyadati jis mein koi haraj nahin, woh kisi ko is iraday se hadiya-o-tohfa dena hai ke yeh mujhe is se zyada de. Phir aap ne yeh aayat parh kar farmaya ke Allah ke paas sawab to Zakat ke ada karne ka hai. Zakat dene walon ko bohat barkatein hoti hain. Sahih hadith mein hai ke jo shakhs ek khajoor bhi sadqay mein de lekin halal tor se hasil ki hui ho, to use Allah Ta'ala Rahman-o-Raheem apne dayein hath mein leta hai aur is tarah palta aur barhata hai jis tarah tum mein se koi apne ghore ya oont ke bachay ki parwarish karta hai, yahan tak ke wahi ek khajoor Uhud pahar se bhi bari ho jati hai. Allah hi Khaliq-o-Raziq hai. Insan apni maa ke pait se nanga, be-ilm, be-kaan, be-aankh, be-taqat nikalta hai, phir Allah Ta'ala use sab cheezein ata farmata hai. Maal, malkiyat, kamai, tijarat, garz beshumar neamatein ata farmata hai. Do sahabiyon ka bayan hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue, us waqt aap kisi kaam mein mashghool thay, hum ne bhi aap ka hath bataya. Aap ne farmaya ke dekho, sar hilne lage tab tak bhi rozi se koi mehroom nahin rehta. Insan nanga bhooka duniya mein aata hai, ek chhilka bhi us ke badan par nahin hota, phir Rabb hi use roziyan deta hai. Is hayat ke baad tumhein maar dalega, phir Qayamat ke din zinda karega. Allah ke siwa tum jin jin ki ibadat kar rahe ho, un mein se ek bhi in baton mein se kisi ek par qaboo nahin rakhta. In kamon mein se ek bhi koi nahin kar sakta. Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala hi tanha Khaliq, Raziq aur maut-o-zindagi ka malik hai, wahi Qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq ko jila dega.

Is ki muqaddas munazzah mu'azzam aur izzat-o-jalal wali zaat is se paak hai ke koi is ka shareek ho ya is jaisa ho ya is ke barabar ho ya is ki aulad ho ya maa baap hon. Woh Ahad hai, Samad hai, Fard hai, maa baap aulad se paak hai, is ka kuf koi nahin.

Zameen ki islah Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at mein muzmar hai. Mumkin hai barr ya'ni khushki se murad maidan aur jungle hon aur bahr ya'ni tari se murad shehar aur dehat hon. Warna zahir hai ke barr kehte hain khushki ko aur bahr kehte hain tari ko. Khushki ke fasad se murad barish ka na hona, paidawar ka na hona, qahat-saliyon ka aana. Tari ke fasad se murad barish ka ruk jana jis se pani ke janwar andhay ho jate hain. Insaan ka qatl aur kashtiyon ka jabran cheen jhapatt lena yeh khushki tari ka fasad hai. Bahr se murad jazeeray aur barr se murad shehar aur bastiyan hain. Lekin awwal qaul zyada zahir hai aur isi ki ta'eed Muhammad bin Ishaq ki is riwayat se hoti hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ailah ke badshah se sulah ki aur uska bahr ya'ni shehar usi ke naam kardiya. Phalon ka, anaj ka nuqsan darasal insaan ke gunahon ki wajah se hai, Allah ke nafarman zameen ke bigadne wale hain. Aasman-o-zameen ki islah Allah ki ibadat-o-ita'at se hai. Abu Dawood mein hadith hai ke zameen par ek hadd ka qaim hona zameen walon ke haq mein chalees din ki barish se behtar hai. Yeh is liye ke hadd qaim hone se mujrim gunahon se baaz rahenge aur jab gunah na honge to aasmani aur zamini barkatein logon ko hasil hongi. Chunancha aakhir zamane mein jab Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (Alaihis Salam / A.S) utrenge aur is pak shariyat ke mutabiq faislay karenge, maslan khanzeer ka qatl, saleeb ki shikast, jizye ka tark ya'ni Islam ki qabooliyat ya jang, phir jab aap ke zamane mein Dajjal aur uske mureed halak ho jayenge, Yajooj Majooj tabah ho jayenge to zameen se kaha jayega ke apni barkatein lota de. Us din ek anaar logon ki ek badi jama'at ko kafi hoga, itna bada hoga ke uske chhilke talay yeh sab log saya hasil karlein. Ek oontni ka doodh ek pooray qabeelay ko kifayat karega. Yeh sari barkatein sirf Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shariyat ke jari karne ki wajah se hongi. Jaise jaise adl-o-insaf mutabiq-e-shar'a shareef badhega waise waise khair-o-barkat badhti chali jayegi. Is ke bar-khilaf fajir shakhs ke baray mein hadith shareef mein hai ke uske marne par banday, shehar, darakht aur janwar sab rahat pa lete hain. Musnad Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal mein hai ke Ziyad ke zamane mein ek theli payi gayi jis mein khajoor ki badi guthli jaise gehun ke danay thay aur us mein likha hua tha ke yeh us zamane mein ugtay thay jis mein adl-o-insaf ko kaam mein laya jata tha. Zaid bin Aslam se marwi hai ke fasad se murad shirk hai lekin yeh qaul ta'ammul talab hai. Phir farmata hai ke maal aur paidawar ki aur phir anaj ki kami bator-e-aazmaish ke aur bator-e-un ke ba'az a'amal ke badlay ke hai. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa balawnahum bil-hasanati was-sayyi'ati la'allahum yarji'oon) (Surah Al-A'raf: 168) hum ne unhein bhalaiyon buraiyon mein mubtala kiya taake woh laut jayen. Tum zameen mein chal phir kar aap hi dekh lo ke tum se pehle jo mushrik thay us ke natijay kya huay? Rasoolon ki na manne, Allah ke sath kufr karne ka kya wabaal un par aaya? Yeh dekho aur ibrat hasil karo.

Allah ke deen mein mustahkam ho jao. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko deen par jam jaane ki aur chusti se Allah ki farmanbardari karne ki hidayat karta hai aur farmata hai. Mazboot deen ki taraf hamah-tan mutawajjeh ho jao. Is se pehle ke Qayamat ka din aaye. Jab is ke aane ka Allah ka hukum ho chuke ga phir is hukum ko ya is aane wali jamaat ko koi taal nahin sakta. Us din nek bad alaihda alaihda ho jayenge. Ek jamaat jannat mein, ek jamaat bhadakti hui aag mein. Kafir apne kufr ke bojh tale dab rahe honge. Log apne kiye hue nek aamal behtareen aaram-deh zakheere par khush-o-khurram honge. Rabb unhein un ki nekiyon ka ajar bahut zyada badha chadha kar kayi kayi gunaah karke de raha hoga. Ek ek neki das das balkeh saat saat sau balkeh is se bhi bahut zyada karke unhein milegi. Kuffar Allah ke dost nahin lekin taham un par bhi zulm na hoga.

Musalman bhai ki iaanat par jahannam se nijaat ka waada. Baarish ke aane se pehle bheeni bheeni hawaon ka chalna aur logon ko baarish ki umeed dilana. Is ke baad meena barsana taake bastiyan aabad hon aur jaandaar zinda rahein, samundaron aur daryaaon mein jahaaz aur kashtiyan chalein. Kyunke kashtiyon ka chalna bhi hawa par mauqoof hai. Ab tum apni tijaarat aur kamai dhande ke liye idhar se udhar, idhar se udhar ja sako. Pas tumhein chahiye ke Allah Ta'ala ki in beshumaar anginat naimaton par us ka shukriya ada karo. Phir apne Nabi ko taskeen aur tasalli dene ke liye farmata hai ke agar aap ko log jhutlate hain to aap ise koi anokhi baat na samjhein. Aap se pehle ke rasoolon ko bhi un ki ummaton ne aise hi tedhe tirche fiqre sunaye hain. Woh bhi saaf roshan aur wazeh daleelein, maujize aur ahkaam laye the, bil-aakhir jhutlane wale azaab ke shikanje mein kas diye gaye aur mominon ko us waqt har qism ki burai se nijaat mili. Apne fazl se Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ne apne nafs-e-kareem par yeh baat laazim kar li hai ke woh apne ba-imaan bandon ko madad de ga. Jaise farmaan hai aayat (KATABA RABBUKUM 'ALA NAFSIHIR RAHMAH) (Surah Al-An'am: 54). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hadees hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo musalman apne musalman bhai ki aabroo bacha le, Allah par haq hai ke woh us se jahannam ki aag ko hata le. Phir aap ne padha aayat (WA KAANA HAQQAN 'ALAYNA NASRUL MU'MINEEN) (Surah Ar-Rum: 47).

Na-umeedi ke andheron mein umeed ke ujale, Rahmat-o-Zahmat ki hawayein. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke woh hawayein bhejta hai jo badalon ko uthati hain, ya toh samundar par se ya jis tarah aur jahan se Allah ka hukum ho. Phir Rabb-ul-Aalameen abr ko aasman par phaila deta hai, use badha deta hai, thode ko zyada kar deta hai. Tum ne aksar dekha hoga ke balisht do-balisht ka abr utha, phir jo woh phaila toh aasman ke kinare dhanp liye. Aur kabhi yeh bhi dekha hoga ke samundaron se pani ke bhare abr uthte hain. Isi mazmoon ko aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖ 57؀) (7. Al-A'raf: 57) mein bayan farmaya hai. Phir use tukde-tukde aur teh-ba-teh kar deta hai. Woh pani se siyah ho jate hain. Zameen ke qareeb ho jate hain. Phir barish in badalon ke darmiyan se barasne lagti hai, jahan barshi wahin ke logon ki baachein khil gayin. Phir farmata hai, yahi log barish se na-umeed ho chuke the aur poori na-umeedi ke waqt, balkeh na-umeedi ke baad un par barishein barasin aur jal-thal ho gaye. Do dafa 'min qabl' ka lafz lana takeed ke liye hai. 'Ha' ki zameer ka marja inzal hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh taseesi dalalat ho. Yani barish hone se pehle yeh is ke mohtaj the aur woh haajat poori ho is se pehle waqt ke khatam ho jane ke qareeb barish na hone ki wajah se yeh mayoos ho chuke the. Phir is na-umeedi ke baad daf'atan abr uthta hai aur baras jata hai aur rail-pel kar deta hai. Aur un ki khushk zameen tar ho jati hai, qahat-sali tarsali se badal jati hai. Ya toh zameen saaf chatyal maidan thi ya har taraf hariyawal dikhayi dene lagti hai. Dekh lo ke Parwardigar-e-Aalam barish se kis tarah murda zameen ko zinda kar deta hai. Yaad rakho jis Rabb ki yeh qudrat tum dekh rahe ho, woh ek din murdon ko in qabron se bhi nikalne wala hai, halankeh un ke jism gal-sad gaye honge. Samajh lo ke Allah har cheez par qadir hai. Phir farmata hai, agar hum baad-e-tund chalayen, agar aandhiyan aa jayen aur un ki lehlati hui khetiyan pajmurda ho jayen toh woh phir se kufr karne lag jate hain. Chunancha Surah Al-Waqi'ah mein bhi yahi bayan hua hai. Aayat (اَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَّا تَحْرُثُوْنَ 63ۭ) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 63) se (بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُوْمُوْنَ 67؀) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 67) tak. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain, hawayein aath qisam ki hain, chaar rahmat ki, chaar zahmat ki. Nashirat, Mubashirat, Mursilat aur Zariyat toh rahmat ki hain. Aur Aqeem, Sarsar, Aasif aur Qasif azaab ki hain. In mein pehli do khushkiyon ki hain aur aakhri do tari ki. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, hawayein doosri se musakhkhar hain, yani doosri zameen se. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne Qaum-e-Aad ki halakat ka irada kiya toh hawaon ke darogha ko yeh hukum diya. Us ne daryaft kiya ke janab-e-bari! Kya hawaon ke khazane mein itna soorakh kar doon jitna bail ka natha hota hai? Toh farman-e-Allah hua ke nahin, nahin! Agar aisa hua toh kul zameen aur zameen ki poori cheezein ulat-palat ho jayengi.

Itna nahin balkay itna rozan kar jitna angoothi mein nageena hota hai. Ab sirf itnay soorakh se woh hawa chali jo jahan pahunchi wahan bhus ura diya. Jis cheez par se guzri usay benishan kar diya. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ka marfoo hona makrooh hai, zyada zahir yehi hai ke yeh khud Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (Razi Allahu Anhu) ka qaul hai.

Ya toh zameen saaf chatyal maidan thi ya har taraf hariyawal dikhayi dene lagti hai. Dekh lo ke Parwardigar-e-Aalam barish se kis tarah murda zameen ko zinda kar deta hai. Mas'ala-e-Sama-e-Mauta. Bari Ta'ala Azzawajal farmata hai ke jis tarah yeh teri qudrat se kharij hai ke murdon ko jo qabron mein hon tu apni aawaz suna sake. Aur jis tarah yeh namumkin hai ke behre shakhs ko jabke woh peeth phere munh more ja raha ho tu apni baat suna sake. Isi tarah se jo haq se andhe hain tu un ki rehbari hidayat ki taraf nahin kar sakta. Haan Allah tu har cheez par qadir hai jab woh chahe murdon ko zindon ko aawaz suna sakta hai. Hidayat-o-Zalalat uski taraf se hai. Tu sirf unhein suna sakta hai jo ba-imaan hon aur Allah ke samne jhukne wale us ke farmanbardar hon. Yeh log haq ko sunte hain aur maante bhi hain yeh tu halat musalman ki hui aur is se pehle jo halat bayan hui hai woh kafir ki hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Innama yastajibullazina yasma'una wal-mauta yab'asuhumullahu summa ilaihi yurja'un) (Surah Al-An'am: 36). Teri pukar wahi qabool karenge jo kaan dhar kar sunenge murdon ko Allah Ta'ala zinda karke uthayega phir sab us ki taraf lautaye jayenge. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un mushrikeen se jo jang-e-Badr mein musalmanon ke hathon qatl kiye gaye the aur Badr ki khaiyon mein un ki lashein phenk di gayi thi un ki maut ke teen din baad un se khitab karke unhein danta aur ghairat dilayi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne yeh dekh kar arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap un se khitab karte hain jo mar kar murda ho gaye, tu aap ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai tum bhi meri is baat ko jo main unhein keh raha hoon utna nahin sunte jitna yeh sun rahe hain. Haan woh jawab nahin de sakte. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne is waqiye ko Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki zabani sun kar farmaya ke aap ne yun farmaya ke woh ab bakhoobi jaante hain ke jo main un se kehta tha woh haq hai phir aap ne murdon ke na sun sakne par isi aayat se istidlal kiya ke aayat (Innaka la tusmi'ul-mauta wa la tusmi'us-summad-du'a iza wallau mudbirin) (Surah An-Naml: 80). Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zinda kar diya tha yahan tak ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh baat unhon ne sun li taake unhein poori nidamat aur kaafi sharm-sari ho. Lekin ulama ke nazdeek Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ki riwayat bilkul sahih hai kyunke is ke bohat se shawahid hain. Ibn Abdul Barr ne Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marfoo'an ek riwayat sehat karke warid ki hai ke jo shakhs apne kisi musalman bhai ki qabr ke paas guzarta hai jise yeh duniya mein pehchanta tha aur use salam karta hai tu Allah uski rooh lauta deta hai yahan tak ke woh jawab de.

Paidaish-e-insan ki marhala-war rodad, insan ki taraqqi-o-tanazzul. Iski asal toh mitti se hai. Phir nutfay se, phir khoon-e-basta se, phir gosht ke lothray se, phir usay haddiyan pehnayi jati hain, phir haddiyon par gosht-o-post pehnaya jata hai, phir rooh phonki jati hai, phir maa ke pait se za'eef-o-naheef ho kar nikalta hai, phir thoda thoda barhta hai aur mazboot hota jata hai, phir bachpan ke zamanay ki baharein dekhta hai, phir jawani ke qareeb pohanchta hai, phir jawan hota hai, aakhir nashonuma mauqoof ho jati hai. Ab qawi phir muzmahil honay shuru hotay hain, taqatein ghatnay lagti hain, adher umar ko pohanchta hai, phir buddha hota phoos ho jata hai. Taqat ke baad yeh kamzori bhi qabil-e-ibrat hoti hai. Ke himmat past hai, dekhna, sunna, chalna phirna, uthna, uchakna, pakarna, garz har taqat ghat jati hai. Rafta rafta bilkul jawab de jati hai aur sari siftin mutaghayyar ho jati hain. Badan par jhurriyan par jati hain, rukhsar pichak jatay hain, daant toot jatay hain, baal safaid ho jatay hain. Yeh quwwat ke baad ki za'eefi aur barhapa. Woh jo chahta hai karta hai. Banana bigarna uski qudrat ke adna karishmay hain. Sari makhlooq uski ghulam, woh sab ka malik, woh Alim-o-Qadir, na us ka sa kisi ka ilm, na us jaisi kisi ki qudrat. Hazrat Atiya Aufi kehte hain main ne is ayat ko zu'afa tak Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ke samnay parha toh aap ne bhi isay tilawat ki aur farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke samnay is ayat ko itna hi parha tha jo aap parhnay lagay jis tarah main ne tumhari qira'at par qira'at shuru kar di (Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Musnad-e-Ahmad).

Wapsi namumkin hogi. Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke kuffar duniya aur aakhirat ke kamon se bilkul jahil hain. Duniya mein unki jahalat toh yeh hai ke Allah ke sath auron ko shareek karte rahe aur aakhirat mein yeh jahalat karenge ke qasmein khakar kahenge ke hum duniya mein sirf ek sa'at hi rahe. Is se unka maqsad yeh hoga ke itne thode se waqt mein hum par koi hujjat qaim nahin hui. Hamein mazoor samjha jaye. Isi liye farmaya ke yeh jaise yahan behki behki baatein kar rahe hain duniya mein yeh behke hue hi rahe. Farmata hai ke ulama-e-kiram jis tarah unke is kehne par duniya mein unhein dalail de kar qail-o-maqool karte rahe aakhirat mein bhi unse kahenge ke tum jhooti qasmein kha rahe ho. Tum Kitabullah yani kitab-e-a'maal mein apni paidaish se le kar jee uthne tak thehre rahe lekin tum be-ilm aur nire jahil log ho. Pas Qayamat ke din zalimon ko apne kartoot se mazrat karna mehez be-sood rahega. Aur duniya ki taraf lautaye na jayenge. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa in yasta'tibu famahum minal mu'tabeen 24) (Surah Fussilat: 24) yani agar woh duniya ki taraf lautna chahein toh laut nahin sakte.

Pas Qayamat ke din zalimon ko apne kartoot se mazrat karna mehez be-sood rahega. Aur duniya ki taraf lautaye na jayenge. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa in yasta'tibu famahum minal mu'tabeen 24) (Surah Fussilat: 24) yani agar woh duniya ki taraf lautna chahein toh laut nahin sakte.

Namaz mein muqtadi aur imam ka talluq. Haq ko hum ne is Kalam-e-Pak mein poori tarah wazeh kar diya hai aur misalein de de kar samjha diya hai ke logon par haq khul jaye aur is ki tabedari mein lag jayen. In ke paas toh koi bhi mojza aa jaye kaisa hi nishan-e-haq dekh lein lekin yeh jhat se bila-ghaur ala-al-faur kahenge ke yeh jadu hai, batil hai, jhoot hai. Dekhiye chand ko do tukray hote dekhte hain aur iman nahin late. Khud Quran-e-Kareem ki ayat (Innal-lazina haqqat alaihim kalimat-u-Rabbika la yu'minun) (Surah Yunus: 96) mein hai ke jin par tere Rabb ki baat sabit ho chuki hai woh iman nahin layenge go un ke paas tamam nishaniyan aa jayen yahan tak ke woh dardnak azab ka mu'aina kar lein. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke be-ilm logon ke dilon par isi tarah Allah ki mohar lag jati hai. Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap sabr kijiye in ki mukhalifat aur dushmani par, darguzar kiye chale jaiye. Allah ka wada sacha hai woh zaroor tumhein ek din in par ghalib karega aur tumhari imdad farmaye ga. Aur duniya aur akhirat mein tujhe aur tere tabedaron ko mukhalifeen par ghalba de ga. Tumhein chahiye ke apne kaam par lage raho, haq par jam jao, is se ek inch idhar udhar na hato, isi mein sari hidayat hai, baqi sab batil ke dher hain. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ek martaba subh ki namaz mein thay ke ek khariji ne aap ka naam le kar zor se is ayat ki tilawat ki: (Wa laqad uhiya ilaika wa ilal-lazina min qablika la'in ashrakta la-yahbatanna 'amaluka wa la-takunanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Aap ne khamoshi se is ayat ko suna, samjha aur namaz hi mein is ke jawab mein ayat (Fasbir inna wa'dallahi haqqun wa la yastakhiffannakal-lazina la yuqinun) (Surah Ar-Rum: 60) tilawat farmayi. (Ibn-e-Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Woh hadith jis se is mubarak surah ki fazilat aur is ki qirat ka subh ki namaz mein mustahab hona sabit hota hai: Ek sahabi (R.A) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek din subh ki namaz parhate hue isi surah ki qirat ki. Asna-e-qirat mein aap ko wahm sa ho gaya, farigh ho kar farmane lage tum mein ba'az aise log bhi hain jo hamare sath namaz mein shamil hote hain lekin baqaida theek thak wuzu nahin karte. Tum mein se jo bhi hamare sath namaz mein shamil ho use achi tarah wuzu karna chahiye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is ki asnad hasan hai, matan bhi hasan hai aur is mein ek ajeeb bhed hai aur bahut bari khair hai aur woh yeh ke aap ke muqtadiyon ke wuzu bilkul durust na hone ka asar aap par bhi para. Pas sabit hua ke muqtadiyon ki namaz imam ki namaz ke sath mu'allaq hai.
